riddle_english: Winter leaves and spring comes. Guess a character from Water Margin.
riddle_hint: 時遷 literally suggests time or seasons moving on.
riddle_note: Literary character riddle based on a name from Water Margin.

riddle_original: 霸王別姬，猜一種古代中國文學體裁。
riddle_english: The Hegemon-King parts from his consort. Guess an ancient Chinese literary genre.
riddle_hint: Xiang Yu, the Hegemon-King, was from Chu; parting words or laments point to 辭.
riddle_note: Literary and historical allusion pointing to Songs of Chu.

riddle_original: 雙花飄香，猜一近現代中國藝術家。
riddle_english: Two flowers give off fragrance. Guess a modern Chinese artist.
riddle_hint: 梅 and 蘭 are both flowers; 芳 means fragrance.
riddle_note: Name-based character riddle pointing to Peking opera artist Mei Lanfang.

riddle_original: 塊塊磚頭疊起，外層鋪上水泥。估一藝術品
riddle_english: Bricks are stacked piece by piece, and the outside is covered with cement. Guess an artwork.
riddle_hint: 形容雕塑堆砌、塑形的製作過程

riddle_original: 有身無手，有口無舌，日日講不停。
riddle_english: It has a body but no hands, a mouth but no tongue, and talks nonstop every day.

riddle_original: 一個黑盒，入面有戲，唔出街都睇到世界。
riddle_english: A black box with shows inside; without going out, you can see the world.

riddle_original: 越洗越髒，越擦越黑
riddle_english: The more it is washed, the dirtier it gets; the more it is wiped, the blacker it becomes.

riddle_original: 補時贏波，估一汽車品牌。
riddle_english: Winning the match in stoppage time. Guess a car brand.
riddle_hint: 補時 means stoppage time in football; 捷 suggests victory, forming a phrase that points to 保時捷.
riddle_note: Sports-context pun based on Cantonese/Chinese football vocabulary and the car brand name.

riddle_original: 乜嘢門點都關唔埋？
riddle_english: What kind of goal or door can never be closed?
riddle_hint: 門 can mean door or goal; a sports goal is not something you close like a door.
riddle_note: Wordplay based on the double meaning of 門.

riddle_original: 一物三口，有腿沒手。誰要沒它，難見親友。估一物件
riddle_english: One thing has three openings, legs but no hands. Without it, one can hardly meet friends and relatives. Guess an object.

riddle_original: 舉重比賽，估一成語
riddle_english: A weightlifting competition. Guess an idiom.

riddle_original: 唔用腳踢，唔用手揸，雙方隔網，你打我爬。估一運動項目
riddle_english: No kicking with feet, no holding with hands; two sides face each other across a net, you hit and I scramble. Guess a sport.

riddle_original: 有頭無身，有身無尾，日日追你跑
riddle_english: It has a head but no body, a body but no tail, and chases you every day.

riddle_original: 兩間屋仔窄一窄，入面住住十個人客，估一物品
riddle_english: Two narrow little houses, with ten guests living inside. Guess an object.

riddle_original: 咩動物識桌球？
riddle_english: Which animal knows how to play snooker?

riddle_original: 唔開燈計數。猜一動作。
riddle_english: Counting without turning on the lights. Guess an action.

riddle_original: 禿頭撐傘，估一成语
riddle_english: A bald head holding an umbrella. Guess an idiom.

riddle_original: 抱住老乸生蛋，估一款廣州零食。
riddle_english: Holding a hen while it lays eggs. Guess a Guangzhou snack.
riddle_hint: 欖 sounds like 攬, meaning to hold or hug; 雞公欖 is a traditional Guangzhou snack.
riddle_note: Grounded in Guangzhou snack culture and Cantonese homophone wordplay.

riddle_original: 一間屋仔兩邊過，五男二女齊齊坐，何事打起來？因為家財未分妥。估一物。
riddle_english: A little house with two sides; five men and two women sit together. Why do they start fighting? Because the family property has not been divided properly. Guess an object.
riddle_hint: A traditional Chinese abacus has two upper beads and five lower beads on each rod.
riddle_note: Traditional object riddle; 打算盤 also means to calculate or scheme.

riddle_original: 一點便起飛。估一水果。
riddle_english: With one dot, it takes flight. Guess a fruit.
riddle_hint: From the idiom 畫龍點睛: once the dragon eyes are dotted in, the dragon comes alive and flies away.
riddle_note: Depends on the classical Chinese idiom 畫龍點睛 and points to 龍眼, longan.

riddle_original: 李小龍的飲料，估一飲品。
riddle_english: Bruce Lee's drink. Guess a beverage.
riddle_hint: Bruce Lee is strongly associated with kung fu; 功夫茶 is a traditional Cantonese/Chinese tea-drinking practice.
riddle_note: Connects Bruce Lee pop-cultural knowledge with traditional tea culture.

riddle_original: 紅船裝紅貨，宜行不宜坐，坐親弊家伙。估一物。
riddle_english: A red boat carries red cargo; it should move, not sit still. If it sits, trouble follows. Guess an object.
riddle_hint: A charcoal-heated iron must keep moving to avoid scorching clothes.
riddle_note: Traditional household object riddle; 弊家伙 means trouble or bad news in Cantonese.

riddle_original: 黑嘴雀，落田窩，食水少，講話多。估一物。
riddle_english: A black-beaked bird lands in a field hollow; it drinks little water but speaks a lot. Guess an object.
riddle_hint: The black tip is the brush point; it uses little ink or water but produces many written words.
riddle_note: Traditional object riddle about the writing brush.

riddle_original: 駝背彎腰露齒牙，平生不入寺門家，大小官員都要我，個個低頭任我耙。估一物。
riddle_english: Hunched and bent, showing its teeth; it never enters temples, yet officials high and low all need it, bowing their heads for it to rake. Guess an object.
riddle_hint: A comb has teeth and is used as people lower their heads.
riddle_note: Traditional object riddle about a common grooming tool.

riddle_original: 一杆頭頂閃金星，輪流上盤蕩鞦韆，有時高來有時低，鐵心落定最公平。估一物。
riddle_english: A pole with a golden star on top; things take turns swinging on the pan, sometimes high and sometimes low, but once the iron heart settles, it is fairest. Guess an object.
riddle_hint: A traditional balance scale swings until the weight settles.
riddle_note: Traditional object riddle about weighing and fair measurement.

riddle_original: 自從三月下田周，雨水紛紛腳下流，兩耳唔聞孤雁叫，定無爹媽掛佢憂。估一物。
riddle_english: Since March it has stood in the fields, rainwater flowing at its feet; its two ears do not hear the lone goose cry, and no parents worry about it. Guess an object.
riddle_hint: A scarecrow stands in the fields and has no real hearing or family.
riddle_note: Traditional rural object riddle about a scarecrow.

riddle_original: 四四方方一條柴，做官做宦做太太。綾羅綢緞都穿過，未曾着過半對鞋。估一物。
riddle_english: A square-cut piece of wood can play officials, nobles, and ladies; it has worn silk and satin, but never half a pair of shoes. Guess an object.
riddle_hint: A wooden puppet can play many roles in traditional puppet theatre.
riddle_note: Traditional theatre object riddle about wooden puppets.

riddle_original: 紅布包白布，白布包豬膏，豬膏包紅棗。估一水果。
riddle_english: Red cloth wraps white cloth; white cloth wraps lard; lard wraps a red date. Guess a fruit.
riddle_hint: Describes a fruit with red skin, white flesh, and a reddish-brown seed inside.
riddle_note: Traditional-style descriptive riddle; suitable for children and folk riddle context.

riddle_original: 艇仔合艇仔，入面有兩個孖仔。估一種農作物。
riddle_english: One little boat joins another little boat, with a pair of twins inside. Guess a crop.
riddle_hint: The little boats refer to the peanut shell; the twins are the two peanut kernels inside.
riddle_note: Traditional-style descriptive riddle, suitable for children and folk riddle context.

riddle_original: 青布包白布，白布包蝦，蝦包醋。打一植物。
riddle_english: Green cloth wraps white cloth; white cloth wraps shrimp; shrimp wraps vinegar. Guess a plant.
riddle_hint: Green cloth = outer peel; white cloth = white pith; shrimp = segment-shaped flesh; vinegar = sour taste.
riddle_note: 畢椂 is a Cantonese/local name for pomelo.

riddle_original: 細時着鞋着襪，大時披頭散髮。打一植物。
riddle_english: When young, it wears shoes and socks; when grown, its hair hangs loose. Guess a plant.
riddle_hint: Young corn is wrapped neatly in green husks; mature corn shows loose corn silk at the top.
riddle_note: Traditional-style descriptive plant riddle, suitable for children and folk riddle context.

riddle_original: 一條棍仔頂塊瓦，公婆仔乸跔地下。打一植物。
riddle_english: A little stick holds up a tile; old men, old women, boys, and girls crouch underground. Guess a plant.
riddle_hint: The stick is the long leaf stalk; the tile is the broad taro leaf; taros of all sizes grow low or underground.
riddle_note: Traditional-style descriptive plant riddle using vivid rural imagery.

riddle_original: 食乜嘢昆蟲會瘦？
riddle_english: Which insect would make you thin if you ate it?
riddle_hint: 食蟻獸 means anteater, but sounds like 食蟻瘦, meaning eating ants makes you thin.
riddle_note: Cantonese homophone joke; 乜嘢 means what.

riddle_original: 咩水果最不保值？
riddle_english: Which fruit holds its value the least?
riddle_hint: 蕉 sounds like 朝 in 朝不保夕, meaning uncertain from morning to evening.
riddle_note: Light Cantonese homophone riddle based on a common idiom.

riddle_original: 咩嘢動物一世都唔識長高？
riddle_english: Which animal never grows taller in its whole life?
riddle_hint: 龜苓膏 sounds like 龜零高, meaning a turtle with zero height.
riddle_note: Cantonese homophone joke based on the dessert name turtle jelly.

riddle_original: 學生最怕乜嘢魚？
riddle_english: Which fish are students most afraid of?
riddle_hint: 東星斑 sounds like Don't 升班, meaning do not advance to the next grade.
riddle_note: Cantonese-English code-mixed pun involving a fish name and school promotion.

riddle_original: 紅門框，白蚊帳，入面有個癲和尚。估一人體部位。
riddle_english: A red doorframe, a white mosquito net, and a mad monk inside. Guess a body part.
riddle_hint: The red frame is the lips, the white net is the teeth, and the mad monk is the tongue.
riddle_note: Traditional children's body-part riddle.

riddle_original: 話說有架飛機畀人劫咗，啲乘客會對劫機者講啲咩呢？估一手機品牌。
riddle_english: A plane has been hijacked. What would the passengers say to the hijacker? Guess a mobile phone brand.
riddle_hint: Cantonese pun: 落機呀 means get off the plane and sounds like Nokia.
riddle_note: Requires Cantonese pronunciation and knowledge of the mobile phone brand Nokia.

riddle_original: 鯊魚食咗紅豆會變咩嘢？
riddle_english: What does a shark become after eating red beans?
riddle_hint: 紅豆鯊 sounds like 紅豆沙, a red bean dessert soup or paste.
riddle_note: Cantonese food pun based on a familiar dessert name.

riddle_original: 邊種機器辦事效率最低？
riddle_english: Which machine is the least efficient at getting things done?
riddle_hint: 拖拉 means to procrastinate or work slowly; 拖拉機 means tractor.
riddle_note: Cantonese/Chinese wordplay based on the literal components of the machine name.

riddle_original: 餐具上火架，估一食物。
riddle_english: A piece of tableware is put over the fire. Guess a food.
riddle_hint: 叉 means fork or skewer; 燒 means roasted or burned, forming 叉燒.
riddle_note: Wordplay on the written components of the food name char siu.

riddle_original: 緝毒犬放工，猜一職業。
riddle_english: A drug-sniffing dog gets off work. Guess an occupation.
riddle_hint: 文員 sounds like 聞完, meaning finished smelling or sniffing.
riddle_note: Cantonese homophone joke involving a common office occupation.

riddle_original: 大哥住山南，二哥住山北，感情雖是好，終身見唔得。估一人體部位。
riddle_english: Elder brother lives south of the mountain, second brother lives north; though close, they can never meet. Guess a body part.
riddle_hint: The two ears are on opposite sides of the head.
riddle_note: Traditional children's body-part riddle.

riddle_original: 十個兄弟結個社，頭上各頂一片瓦，小事分開兩家做，大事齊心也不怕。估一人體部位。
riddle_english: Ten brothers form a society, each carrying a little roof on top; for small tasks they split into two families, for big tasks they join forces. Guess a body part.
riddle_hint: The ten fingers have nails; two hands can work separately or together.
riddle_note: Traditional children's body-part riddle.

riddle_original: 珍珠玉女香噴噴，嫁個窮夫竹葉君。五花大綁投河死，明朝解去入衙門。估一食物。
riddle_english: A fragrant pearl-like maiden marries poor Mister Bamboo Leaf; tied up tightly and thrown into the river, then untied and brought to court tomorrow. Guess a food.
riddle_hint: Glutinous rice is wrapped in bamboo leaves, tied, boiled, then unwrapped to eat.
riddle_note: Traditional food riddle about zongzi.

riddle_original: 殺手最中意用咩番欖沖涼？
riddle_english: What kind of olive does a killer most like to bathe with?
riddle_hint: 番欖 or olive plus bathing points to 梘, soap, which sounds like 鐧 in 殺手鐧.
riddle_note: Cantonese homophone pun pointing to the expression 殺手鐧.

riddle_original: 輯毒犬放工，估一職業。
riddle_english: What is the profession position for narcotics dog getting off work?

riddle_original: 阿茂整餅咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "Ah Mou making cakes" mean?
riddle_hint: Refers to making whichever cake is missing; by extension, creating work where there was none.
riddle_note: Cantonese xiehouyu linked to an old Guangzhou/Xiguan teahouse story; often mildly negative.

riddle_original: 老鼠搵貓咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "a mouse looking for a cat" mean?
riddle_hint: A mouse seeking out a cat is bringing trouble upon itself.
riddle_note: Cantonese saying meaning to invite trouble or court disaster.

riddle_original: 刀仔鋸大樹咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "using a little knife to saw down a big tree" mean?
riddle_hint: Using a small tool or limited effort to take on something much bigger.
riddle_note: Can be used positively to mean achieving a large result with limited means.

riddle_original: 黃皮樹鷯哥咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "the myna bird on a wampee tree" mean?
riddle_hint: The bird eats only ripe wampee fruit; 熟 also means familiar or acquainted.
riddle_note: Means someone only cheats or takes advantage of people they know.

riddle_original: 阿崩叫狗咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "Ah Bang calling a dog" mean?
riddle_hint: A person missing front teeth calls the dog unclearly, so the dog thinks it is being driven away.
riddle_note: Means someone or something becomes less obedient the more you call.

riddle_original: 狐狸嗌交咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "foxes arguing" mean?
riddle_hint: Pun on 狐, fox, and 胡 in 胡言, meaning nonsense.
riddle_note: Cantonese/Chinese character pun meaning complete nonsense.

riddle_original: 姜太公封神咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "Jiang Taigong appointing the gods" mean?
riddle_hint: Jiang Taigong grants titles to others but leaves himself out.
riddle_note: Refers to doing things for others with a selfless spirit; from the Fengshen tradition.

riddle_original: 太公分豬肉咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "the clan elder dividing pork" mean?
riddle_hint: In Cantonese ancestral rites, pork offerings are divided among clan members.
riddle_note: Means everyone gets some share or benefit and no one is left out.

riddle_original: 灶君跌落鑊咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "the Kitchen God falling into the wok" mean?
riddle_hint: 蒸神 means steamed god and sounds like 精神, meaning energetic or spirited.
riddle_note: Cantonese homophone pun involving the Kitchen God and cooking imagery.

riddle_original: 吹打佬跌利是咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "a wind-instrument performer dropping his red packet" mean?
riddle_hint: The performer has wasted breath and lost the reward.
riddle_note: Means talking, arguing, or advising in vain, especially with someone unreasonable.

riddle_original: 乾隆皇契仔，估一句俗語/人物名。
riddle_english: Qianlong Emperor's godson. Guess a Cantonese expression or character name.
riddle_hint: From the popular novel 乾隆遊江南; 周日 can imply every day, and 清 means cleared out.
riddle_note: 周日清 refers to spending all one's daily income with no savings.

riddle_original: 桂姐賣布咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "Sister Kwai selling cloth" mean?
riddle_hint: 匹 sounds like 筆, so one bolt of cloth becomes one account or item.
riddle_note: Means accounts or issues should be kept separate and clearly distinguished.

riddle_original: 土地燈籠咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "the Earth God’s lantern" mean?
riddle_hint: Lanterns for the Earth God were left up until morning during traditional worship.
riddle_note: Refers to someone who enjoys nightlife and stays out all night.

riddle_original: 三元宮土地咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "the Earth God of Sanyuan Temple" mean?
riddle_hint: The statue was said to be made of tin, 錫, which sounds like 惜, to cherish or protect.
riddle_note: Means being overly protective of oneself or unwilling to work hard.

riddle_original: 趁墟賣魚尾咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "selling fish tails at a rural market" mean?
riddle_hint: Fishmongers would only sell a fish tail together with the fish mouth or head; 搭嘴 also means to butt in.
riddle_note: Used to describe someone who likes to join conversations uninvited.

riddle_original: 鼎湖上素咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "Dinghu vegetarian deluxe" mean?
riddle_hint: 鼎湖上素 is a famous vegetarian dish from Dinghu Mountain and Qingyun Temple in Zhaoqing.
riddle_note: In Cantonese, 齋 can mean vegetarian or plain, but also no benefit to gain or monotonous.

riddle_original: 冇檳榔嚼出汁，估一成語。
riddle_english: Chewing out juice without any betel nut in the mouth. Guess an idiom.
riddle_hint: If there is no betel nut but juice is still produced by chewing, something has appeared from nothing.
riddle_note: Betel nut chewing was traditionally associated with refreshment and digestion.

riddle_original: 手扶拖拉機咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "a hand tractor" mean?
riddle_hint: 屎 can mean poor or lousy; 巴閉 means acting impressive, boastful, or full of oneself.
riddle_note: Describes someone who is both incompetent and boastful.

riddle_original: 公共電話咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "a public telephone" mean?
reference_answer_original: 有錢有得傾，冇錢冇得傾
riddle_hint: 傾 means to talk; a public phone only works after money is inserted.
riddle_note: Mocks people who only care about money and ignore goodwill or principle.

riddle_original: 狗仔抬轎咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "a little dog carrying a sedan chair" mean?
riddle_hint: A dog cannot literally lift a sedan chair; 抬舉 also means to value, promote, or show favor to someone.
riddle_note: Means failing to appreciate someone's kindness, favor, or recognition.

riddle_original: Quin personatge polític català no va fer un pas cap enrere ni endavant?
riddle_english: Which Catalan political figure did not take a step back or forward?

riddle_original: Soc una capsa amb una ranura estreta i vaig ser confiscada en mig del referèndum. Qui soc?
riddle_english: I am a box with a narrow slot and I was confiscated in the middle of the referendum. Who am I?

riddle_original: Quin polític català va cridar "que us bombin a tots"?
riddle_english: Which Catalan politician shouted 'go bomb yourselves everyone'?

riddle_original: Quin partit polític va enviar el president de la Generalitat a la paperera de la història?
riddle_english: Which political party sent the president of the Generalitat to the dustbin of history?

riddle_original: Quin president sempre sabia quan no tocava?
riddle_english: Which president always knew when it was time to leave?

riddle_original: Expressió d'un expresident de Catalunya per referir-se al seu mètode per aconseguir més competències autonòmiques?
riddle_english: Expression of a former president of Catalonia to refer to his method for achieving more regional powers?

riddle_original: Quina confrontació social nascuda a Barcelona es coneix perquè feia sortir al carrer els dos grups enfrontats amb pipes?
riddle_english: What social confrontation, born in Barcelona, is known for causing the two opposing groups to take to the streets with guns?

riddle_original: Quin nom rep la institució defensora del poble en el territori català?
riddle_english: What name does the institution that defends the people receive in Catalan territory?

riddle_original: Qui és l'avi que va preparar una revolució des de l'exili i va acabar fent història des d'un balcó.
riddle_english: Who is the grandfather who prepared a revolution from exile and ended up making history from a balcony?

riddle_original: L’advocat que va viure a l’exili abans de ser afusellat al lloc on més tard es construiria un estadi que porta el seu nom.
riddle_english: The lawyer who lived in exile before being executed at the site where a stadium bearing his name would later be built.

riddle_original: Soc una modista del segle passat i el meu pentinat em dóna el nom. Qui soc?
riddle_english: I am a dressmaker from the last century and my hairstyle gives me my name. Who am I?

riddle_original: Soc una vall de pedra que guardo memòries de temps de guerra. Qui soc?
riddle_english: I am a valley of stone that holds memories of wartime. Who am I?

riddle_original: Quina reforma va abolir la Generalitat, les Corts Catalanes i el Consell de Cent?
riddle_english: What reform abolished the Generalitat, the Catalan Parliament and the Consell de Cent?

riddle_original: Quin terme, sovint despectiu, es feia servir per referir-se a persones immigrades d’altres zones d’Espanya?
riddle_english: What term, often derogatory, was used to refer to immigrants from other areas of Spain?

riddle_original: Qui no s’enterra al Fossar de les Moreres?
riddle_english: Who is not buried in the Fossar de les Moreres?

riddle_original: Quin militant té cognom d'un riu català i va aconseguir que molts catalans poguessin viure la seva vida sota un arc de Sant Martí?
riddle_english: Which activist has the surname of a Catalan river and managed to ensure that many Catalans could live their lives under a rainbow?

riddle_original: Quin famós pla urbà va dibuixar quadrats amb illes i xamfrans?
riddle_english: Which famous urban plan drew squares with islands and chamfered corners?

riddle_original: Com anomenem al moviment cultural que va fer néixer un certamen literari molt primaveral?
riddle_english: What do we call the cultural movement that gave birth to a very springlike literary contest?

riddle_original: Comte medieval que va deixar més empremta en una bandera que en un camp de batalla.
riddle_english: Medieval count who left a greater mark on a flag than on a battlefield.

riddle_original: L'etiqueta que ha perseguit els traïdors des de la Guerra de Successió.
riddle_english: The label that has haunted traitors since the War of the Spanish Succession.

riddle_original: Quin autobús va des de Zona Universitària fins a Fabra i Puig?
riddle_english: Which bus goes from Zona Universitària to Fabra i Puig?

riddle_original: A quina comarca va ocórrer de la tragèdia pirenaica més important?
riddle_english: In which region did the most important Pyrenean tragedy occur?

riddle_original: Quin poble del Pirineu s’ha fet famós per una disputa per la muntanya que va acabar amb tres morts?
riddle_english: Which town in the Pyrenees became famous for a dispute over the mountain that ended with three deaths?

riddle_original: En quin lloc va caure un dels homes més rics de Catalunya per un barranc?
riddle_english: Where did one of the richest men in Catalonia fall down a ravine?

riddle_original: A quin estany català viu, segons la llegenda, un drac o un monstre?
riddle_english: In which Catalan lake does a dragon or monster live, according to legend?

riddle_original: Quins carros no tenen rodes i recorren els Pirineus?
riddle_english: What chariots have no wheels and travel through the Pyrenees?

riddle_original: De quina regió és la gent que es queda tocada de l'ala per culpa del temps?
riddle_english: Which region are people from if they go a bit crazy because of the weather?

riddle_original: Quin és l'antic poble pesquer tan blanquet i tan car que resulta una mica surrealista?
riddle_english: What is the old fishing village so white and so expensive that it seems a bit surreal?

riddle_original: Trosset de Catalunya que seria una illa si França fos el mar.
riddle_english: A little piece of Catalonia that would be an island if France were the sea.

riddle_original: Poble de pel·lícula que fa por a la tardor i es banya al Mediterrani a l'estiu.
riddle_english: A movie-like town that becomes frightening in autumn and bathes in the Mediterranean in summer.

riddle_original: A quin poble fictici on els germans Biel i Isona es muden amb la seva mare?
riddle_english: What fictional town do siblings Biel and Isona move to with their mother?

riddle_original: Quin objecte és un símbol de resistència i lluita per la llibertat catalana en la tradició popular, tal com diu la cançó?
riddle_english: What object is a symbol of resistance and the fight for Catalan freedom in popular tradition, as the song says?

riddle_original: Quin grup català va popularitzar la frase «és nit freda per ser abril»?
riddle_english: Which Catalan group popularized the phrase "it's a cold night to be April"?

riddle_original: Quin presentador de TV3 posa llum a la foscor?
riddle_english: Which TV3 presenter sheds light on the darkness?

riddle_original: Quina cantant catalana es defineix amb el lema “I am the Catalan Dream”?
riddle_english: Which Catalan singer defines herself with the motto “I am the Catalan Dream”?

riddle_original: Qui canta “Per què he plorat?” enmig del mar i del cel?
riddle_english: Who sings “Why did I cry?” in the middle of the sea and the sky?

riddle_original: Quin nom comparteixen un famós grup de música i un pantà?
riddle_english: What name is shared by a famous music group and a reservoir?

riddle_original: Quina coneguda novel·la d'una escriptora catalana té nom de joia i és alhora un racó ple de terrasses a Gràcia?
riddle_english: Which famous novel by a Catalan author shares its name with a jewel, and is also a spot full of terraces in Gràcia?

riddle_original: Tècnica artística on allò trencat i sense valor es converteix en bellesa.
riddle_english: Artistic technique where what is broken and worthless becomes beauty.

riddle_original: Illa imaginària que simbolitza el viatge cap als nostres somnis i ideals.
riddle_english: Imaginary island that symbolizes the journey towards our dreams and ideals.

riddle_original: Quina nadadora olímpica té cognom de muntanya bonica?
riddle_english: Which Olympic swimmer has a surname that means beautiful mountain?

riddle_original: Motociclista catalana que comparteix cognom amb un cantant espanyol.
riddle_english: Catalan motorcyclist who shares a surname with a Spanish singer.

riddle_original: Quin president del Barça compartia malnom amb el protagonista més poruc de Doraemon?
riddle_english: Which Barça president shared a nickname with the most fearful protagonist of Doraemon?

riddle_original: Quin entrenador del Barça va deixar anar el mític «mai positiu, sempre negatiu» en una roda de premsa?
riddle_english: Which Barça coach uttered the legendary phrase "never positive, always negative" in a press conference?

riddle_original: Quin entrenador català va fer famosa la idea que, si ens llevem ben d’hora i ens posem a pencar, som imparables?
riddle_english: Which Catalan coach made famous the idea that, if we get up early and start working hard, we are unstoppable?

riddle_original: Quin gos va fer de Barcelona una ciutat olímpica?
riddle_english: Which dog made Barcelona an Olympic city?

riddle_original: De quin color és la samarreta d'uns aficionats amb nom de cul?
riddle_english: What color is the shirt of fans with a name meaning 'ass'?

riddle_original: El futbolista amb aires de Tarzán que es trencava la cara pel Barça.
riddle_english: The footballer with Tarzan-like looks who would break his face for Barça.

riddle_original: Pirineuenc capaç de coronar tots els quatre mil dels Alps en menys de tres setmanes.
riddle_english: The Pyrenean who is able to climb all the Alps’ four-thousand-metre peaks in under three weeks.

riddle_original: Cognom dels germans que van posar Sant Boi al mapa del bàsquet mundial.
riddle_english: Surname of the brothers who put Sant Boi on the world basketball map.

riddle_original: El lloc on conviuen una verge, els extraterrestres i el Sant Grial.
riddle_english: The place where a virgin, aliens and the Holy Grail coexist.

riddle_original: Aparec quan sona la música, i els qui em ballen s’agafen de les mans i fan petits saltirons. Qui soc?
riddle_english: I appear when the music starts, and my dancers hold hands and do little jumps. Who am I?

riddle_original: Dos equips, una pilota de beisbol i un pati d'escola català. Quin joc soc?
riddle_english: Two teams, a baseball and a Catalan schoolyard. What game am I?

riddle_original: Postres que li donarem al noi de la mare.
riddle_english: Desserts that we will give to the mother's boy.

riddle_original: Quina flama baixa d’una muntanya per encendre tot un país?
riddle_english: What flame descends from a mountain to ignite an entire country?

riddle_original: Quin bandoler demanem que torni en una cançó popular?
riddle_english: Which bandit do we ask to return in a popular song?

riddle_original: Quina nit les bèsties ballen, els dimonis corren i el foc mana?
riddle_english: What night do beasts dance, demons run and fire rule?

riddle_original: Com anomenem una coneguda anciana amb problemes de cames que marca el compte enrere cap a una data assenyalada?
riddle_english: What do we call a well-known old woman with leg problems who counts down to a specific date?

riddle_original: No soc florista ni llibreter, però un cop l’any omplo els carrers de roses i faig arribar llibres a totes les mans. Qui soc?
riddle_english: I am not a florist or a bookseller, but once a year I fill the streets with roses and bring books into everyone’s hands. Who am I?

riddle_original: Quina torre puja sense maons i tremola abans de tocar el cel?
riddle_english: What tower rises without bricks and trembles before reaching the sky?

riddle_original: Programa de TV3 que mentre explica els contes va dibuixant la història amb materials.
riddle_english: TV3 program that, while telling stories, draws the story with materials.

raw_template_fields.Comments (Optional): Literal translation is "A hand of stories", name of a TV show

riddle_original: Quin personatge famós de TV3 saludava amb ¨Hola, petits energúmens"?
riddle_english: Which famous TV3 character greeted with "Hello, little nerds"?

riddle_hint: This is a two-part riddle (歇后语) that uses a clever visual metaphor to create a funny punchline.
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 冇掩雞籠
riddle_english: A hen house completely missing its front door
riddle_note: Cantonese Chinese; Hong Kong

riddle_original: 食生菜唔使嚼
riddle_english: Swallowing lettuce without even chewing
riddle_note: Cantonese Chinese; Hong Kong

riddle_original: 水瓜打狗
riddle_english: Throwing a soft water-gourd at a stray dog
riddle_note: Cantonese Chinese; Hong Kong

riddle_original: 天下一塊大被
riddle_english: When the entire sky falling down as one massive comforter
riddle_hint: This is a two-part riddle (歇后语) that uses a clever visual metaphor to create a funny punchline.
riddle_note: Cantonese Chinese; Hong Kong

riddle_original: 「 剝皮大樹  」係咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "Tree stripped of its bark" mean?
riddle_note: Cantonese Chinese; Hong Kong

riddle_original: 「 牛皮燈籠 」係咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "lantern made of cow's skin" mean?
riddle_note: Cantonese Chinese; Hong Kong

riddle_original: 什么动物最喜欢评价别人、最挑剔？
riddle_english: Which animal is the most critical and judgmental?
riddle_note: Mandarin Chinese

riddle_original: 为什么蜘蛛拼命工作，就为了买一辆豪华跑车？
riddle_english: Why did the spider work so hard to buy an expensive high-speed car?
reference_answer_english: Because it wanted to be a "Webmaster"
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 哪种水最傲慢、看不起人？
riddle_english: What kind of water is the most arrogant and look-down-on-everyone?
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 为什么变形金刚里的擎天柱去面试工作失败了？
riddle_english: Why did the Transformer, Optimus Prime, fail his job interview?
reference_answer_original: 因为他是“无业游民”（无房一族)
riddle_note: Mandarin Chinese

riddle_original: 为什么红薯（地瓜）总是比普通土豆（马铃薯）有钱？
riddle_english: Why are sweet potatoes always so much wealthier than regular potatoes?
riddle_note: Mandarin Chinese

riddle_original: 哪种蔬菜演技最好、最喜欢小题大作？
riddle_english: Which vegetable is the most dramatic and always overreacts?
riddle_note: Mandarin Chinese

riddle_original: 当一个电脑软件在上班时间极度偷懒，它会变成什么？
riddle_english: What happens when a piece of software gets extremely lazy at work?
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 为什么数字键盘永远没办法和鼠标搞好关系？
riddle_english: Why can't keyboards ever get along with mice?
reference_answer_original: 因为键盘总是对鼠标说：“你没空格”
reference_answer_english: Because the keyboard always says "You lack space"
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 为什么在26个英文字母里，“A”是最孤独的一个？
riddle_english: Why is the letter "A" always the loneliest letter in the alphabet?
reference_answer_english: Because "A" always stands alone in line
riddle_hint: Derived from gaming culture (like League of Legends or Honor of Kings); referring to solo queuing
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 鞋油廠經理是做什麼的？
riddle_english: What does the managing director of a shoe polish factory do?
riddle_note: Cantonese Chinese; Hong Kong

riddle_original: 我的目的是改善经济，没想到改变了社会
riddle_english: My aim was to improve the economy, but I never expected to change society.
riddle_note: 新经济政策原意为了帮助马来人提升经济能力，结果并没有成功，反而导致社会不平等（固打制）

riddle_original: 什么动物最常影响国州议会？
riddle_english: Which animal most often influences Parliament and the state assemblies?

riddle_original: 我们为了自由和公平集结了五次，掀起了黄色浪潮，我们是谁？
riddle_english: We gathered five times for freedom and fair elections, stirring up a yellow wave. Who are we?
reference_answer_english: Bersih Coalition for Clean and Fair Elections

riddle_original: 那天政治人物齐聚一堂，从此就出名了，猜一酒店
riddle_english: That day, all the politicians gathered in one place, and from then on it became famous. Guess a hotel.
riddle_note: 2020年马来西亚政治危机，喜来登事件的地点

riddle_original: 我一般上五年出现一次，近年却频繁出现；很多人需要我，你却不可以带回家
riddle_english: I usually appear once every five years, but in recent years I've been showing up more often; many people need me, but you are not allowed to take me home.

riddle_original: 平时大家都不关注我，只有在不够“数”的时候才会被想起
riddle_english: Usually no one pays attention to me; I’m only remembered when the numbers don’t add up.
riddle_note: 东马（沙巴，砂拉越）长年被西马政治“遗忘”，但近年的全国大选扮演了造王者的角色

riddle_original: 九个人轮流当全国第一人
riddle_english: Nine people take turns being the nation’s number one person.
riddle_note: 最高元首由九个州苏丹轮值

riddle_original: 我等了很多年才等到这份工作，为了这份工作，我还坐过牢
riddle_english: I waited many years before finally getting this job; I even went to prison for it.

riddle_original: 他退休了两次，还是常常听见他的政见
riddle_english: He has retired twice, yet we still often hear his political views.
riddle_note: 马哈迪作为首相退休两次

riddle_original: 他叫新加坡人来马来西亚做外劳
riddle_english: He called Singaporeans to come to Malaysia as foreign workers.

riddle_original: 什么树影响了一个历史王朝
riddle_english: What tree influenced a historical dynasty?
riddle_note: 拜里米苏拉在马六甲树下休息，看见一只鼠鹿自卫将猎狗踢入河里，觉得这是祥瑞之地并以“马六甲树”做为名字在当地建国

riddle_original: 他一句话喊八次以后，全国人民每年都会一起喊
riddle_english: After he shouted one phrase eight times, the whole nation has gone on to shout it together every year.

riddle_original: 全国人民都要遵守的五句话
riddle_english: The five statements that everyone in the country must abide by

riddle_original: 他建立了王朝，却是从别的国家逃亡的王子
riddle_english: He founded a dynasty, yet he was a prince fleeing from another country.

riddle_original: 我经历了三个欧洲的主人，却没有一起离开
riddle_english: I passed through the hands of three European masters, yet I did not leave with any of them.
riddle_note: 殖民时期马六甲被葡萄牙，荷兰，英国殖民

riddle_original: 我失去了王朝，但永远留在了历史课本里
riddle_english: I lost my sultanate, but I remain forever in history textbooks.

riddle_original: 我一生都在为捍卫华文教育而奋斗，就算被褫夺公民权也没关系
riddle_english: All my life, I fought to defend Chinese-language education; even being stripped of my citizenship did not matter.

riddle_original: 我在吉隆坡担任甲必丹，也是吉隆坡的开埠功臣
riddle_english: I served as the Kapitan Cina of Kuala Lumpur and was one of the founding pioneers who opened up Kuala Lumpur.

riddle_original: 一次冲突，换来的是一代人的伤
riddle_english: One conflict, and it leaves a generation scarred.

riddle_original: 那一年我们决定把其中一国踢出去
riddle_english: That was the year we decided to kick one of the countries out.
riddle_note: 新加坡于1965年被马来西亚移除

riddle_original: 我看起来窄，却影响了全球的贸易
riddle_english: I may look narrow, yet I have shaped global trade.

riddle_original: 不是首都，却管理整个国家
riddle_english: Not the capital, yet it administers the whole country.

riddle_original: 我是全国最高，但没有多少人记得我的全名
riddle_english: I’m the tallest in the whole country, but not many people remember my full name.

riddle_original: 踩着彩虹往上走，不是为了上山顶
riddle_english: Walking up on a rainbow, but not to reach a mountain peak.
riddle_note: 黑风洞前有多层彩色阶梯，也是印度教的圣地之一

riddle_original: 我是避暑胜地，但大部分人来的目的都不是避暑
riddle_english: I’m a cool retreat from the heat, but most people who come here aren’t really coming to cool off.
riddle_note: 云顶有马来西亚唯一合法的赌场

riddle_original: 岛瞧不上陆，陆也瞧不上岛
riddle_english: The island looks down on the mainland, and the mainland looks down on the island.

riddle_original: 亚洲大陆没有地方比我“难”
riddle_english: Nowhere on the Asian continent is more “difficult” than me.
riddle_note: 丹绒比艾是亚洲大陆最南端

riddle_original: 我是全国最长的河，养着让人忘不了的鱼
riddle_english: I am the longest river in the country, home to fish that leave a lasting impression.
riddle_note: “忘不了”是拉让江特有的鱼 - 因为价格而忘不了

riddle_original: 什么东西全国连在一起可以绕地球一圈半？
riddle_english: What, if all of it across the whole country were joined together, could circle the Earth one and a half times?

riddle_original: 在凉爽的天气，喝当地种出来的热茶
riddle_english: In cool weather, drink hot tea grown locally.

riddle_original: 马来西亚最多什么歌？
riddle_english: What kind of songs are the most plentiful in Malaysia?
riddle_note: 2026年预计有400-500首新年歌

riddle_original: 我的勇气借给了一代又一代人
riddle_english: My courage has been lent to generation after generation.
riddle_note: 勇气是梁静茹的著名歌曲

riddle_original: 警察比歌迷更喜欢拦下我
riddle_english: The police like stopping me more than my fans do.

riddle_original: 连阿信都把我认错成冠佑
riddle_english: Even Ashin mistakes me for Guanyou.

riddle_original: 我的一首童话，陪伴一代人长大
riddle_english: My song “Fairy Tale” accompanied a whole generation growing up.

riddle_original: 我们是一个跟日本公司撞名的组合
riddle_english: We’re a duo that shares the same name as a Japanese company.

riddle_original: 在国外比赛后才让马来西亚国内的大家认识我
riddle_english: People in Malaysia only came to know me after I competed overseas.

riddle_original: 我是第一位把金曲奖带回来马来西亚的男歌手
riddle_english: I am the first male singer to bring the Golden Melody Awards back to Malaysia.

riddle_original: 我叫对面的人看过来，却没有人记得我的本名
riddle_english: I’m the one who asks the person opposite to look this way, yet no one remembers my real name.
riddle_note: 最出名的歌之一：对面的女孩看过来

riddle_original: 演唱会上递麦，成了我这辈子最忘不了的事
riddle_english: Passing the microphone at the concert became the most unforgettable moment of my life.

riddle_original: 柔佛人民每年都因为这个运动放假
riddle_english: People in Johor get a holiday every year because of this sport.
riddle_note: 柔佛州自2014年起拿下马来西亚超级足球联赛冠军，隔一天便宣布州内假期

riddle_original: 世界第一的位置坐的很久，却没有站上最高的领奖台
riddle_english: He sat in the world No. 1 spot for a long time, yet never stood on the highest podium.

riddle_original: 全国人民等了几十年，还没等来
riddle_english: The whole nation has been waiting for decades, and it still hasn’t come.

riddle_original: 她的水花最小，掌声最大
riddle_english: Her splash is the smallest, but the applause is the loudest.
riddle_note: 马来西亚跳水运动员

riddle_original: 拿了那么多世界冠军，却没有几个人会
riddle_english: It has won so many world championships, yet hardly anyone knows how to play it.
riddle_note: Nicol David（壁球运动员）多次拿下世界冠军，但壁球在马来西亚仍是小众运动

riddle_original: 这个杯已经30年没回来了
riddle_english: This cup hasn’t come back in 30 years.

riddle_original: 火箭不是造出来的，是踩出来的
riddle_english: Rockets aren’t built — they’re pedalled into existence.
riddle_note: 场地自行车运动员，外号是“袖珍火箭”

riddle_original: 联赛还没开始已经知道谁是冠军了
riddle_english: Before the league has even started, everyone already knows who the champion will be.

riddle_original: 我接过了球拍，更接过了全国的希望
riddle_english: I took up the badminton racket—and with it, the hopes of the whole nation.

riddle_original: 名字里带老虎，球迷最怕上场变小猫
riddle_english: Its name has “tiger” in it, but fans fear it turns into a kitten on the field.
riddle_note: 马来西亚国足的名字

riddle_original: 我们一起上榜，一个靠古迹，一个也靠古迹。
riddle_english: We were both listed: one because of its heritage sites, and the other also because of its heritage sites.
riddle_note: 马六甲和槟城乔治市在2008年列入UNESCO世界文化遗产

riddle_original: 早餐，午餐，晚餐都看得见；少了叶子，总少了些东西
riddle_english: Breakfast, lunch, and dinner—you can always see it; without the leaf, something feels missing.

riddle_original: 几十年来，不管日晒雨淋都在骑脚车
riddle_english: For decades, they have been riding a bicycle together, rain or shine.

riddle_original: 我身上有十四条纹，长年在天空中摇荡
riddle_english: I bear fourteen stripes on me, swaying in the sky all year round.

riddle_original: 我曾经是一座城堡，现在只剩下一道“门”；我在马六甲，却是葡萄牙人建成的
riddle_english: I used to be a fortress, and now only a single “gate” remains; I’m in Malacca, yet I was built by the Portuguese.

riddle_original: 有人可以为了我开车几百公里，也有人为我绕路走几百公尺
riddle_english: Some people will drive hundreds of kilometres just for me, while others will detour a few hundred metres to avoid me.

riddle_original: 我的名字里面有茶，但一滴茶都没有；新马两地都在争做我的发源地
riddle_english: My name has the word “tea” in it, but not a single drop of tea; both Singapore and Malaysia claim to be my place of origin.

riddle_original: 最大的花，却没有人想凑近闻
riddle_english: The biggest flower, yet no one wants to go near and smell it.

riddle_original: 飞的越久越好
riddle_english: The longer it flies, the better.

riddle_original: 失去了第一也没关系，没失去双胞胎就好
riddle_english: It’s all right to lose the first one, as long as you don’t lose the twins.

riddle_original: 小时候最好喝的饮料，在家里却喝不到一样的味道
riddle_english: The tastiest drink in childhood—yet somehow, you could never get the same flavor at home.

riddle_original: 我们是一对陪伴了两代人长大的五岁马来双胞胎
riddle_english: We’re a pair of five-year-old Malay twins who grew up alongside two generations.
riddle_note: 马来西亚最著名的儿童动画

riddle_original: 一对双胞胎却只凑得出一撮头发
riddle_english: A pair of twins, yet between them they can only scrape together a tiny tuft of hair.

riddle_original: 我最强的能力是一副眼镜
riddle_english: My greatest power is a pair of glasses.

riddle_original: 我越长大，自己越来越多
riddle_english: The more I grow up, the more of myself there are.

riddle_original: 小时候戴过最多的戒指
riddle_english: When we were kids, what was the ring we wore the most?

riddle_original: 有人泡着吃，有人揉碎了吃
riddle_english: Some people soak it before eating; some people crush it up before eating.
riddle_note: 干脆面

riddle_original: 以前的小学生害怕，现在的小学生不知道
riddle_english: Primary school pupils in the past were afraid of it; primary school pupils today don’t even know what it is.
riddle_note: 马来西亚于2021年起废除小六鉴定考试

riddle_original: 每个礼拜都要写，写越多越好
riddle_english: Every week you have to write it—the more you write, the better.

riddle_original: 从来没有因为把它用完才买新的
riddle_english: You never buy a new one because you’ve used it all up.
riddle_note: 因为一定在用完前不见

riddle_original: 以前小学生每周都要刷干净，现在却不用了
riddle_english: Back then, primary school students had to scrub them clean every week; now they don’t anymore.

riddle_original: 半夜肚子饿第一个想到的地方
riddle_english: When you’re hungry in the middle of the night, what’s the first place that comes to mind?

riddle_original: 东马人从西马带一个行李箱的它回去
riddle_english: People from East Malaysia bring back a suitcase full of it from West Malaysia.

riddle_original: 只要天气不好，我也跟着一起不好
riddle_english: Whenever the weather is bad, I go bad too.
riddle_note: 下雨容易信号丢失

riddle_original: 只有知道今天星期几才知道去哪里找到我
riddle_english: You’ll only know where to find me if you know what day of the week it is.

riddle_original: 我最出名的不是景点，是塞车
riddle_english: What I’m most famous for isn’t my attractions, but my traffic jams.

riddle_original: 在南马是黑的，在北马是红的，都觉得自己才是正宗的
riddle_english: In southern Malaysia, it’s black; in northern Malaysia, it’s red—and both insist theirs is the authentic one.

riddle_original: 马来西亚跑车
riddle_english: Malaysian sports car

riddle_original: 不管搬到哪里，附近一定有的超市
riddle_english: No matter where you move, there’s always a nearby 99 Speedmart.

riddle_original: 摇铃就能聚集一群小朋友
riddle_english: Ring the bell and a crowd of little kids will gather.

riddle_original: 一场婚礼，带着女婿走遍全马派请帖
riddle_english: A wedding, bringing the son-in-law all around Malaysia to hand out invitations.

riddle_original: 从怡保出发，到站上奥斯卡领奖台
riddle_english: Starting out from Ipoh, and ending up on the Oscars stage to receive an award.

riddle_original: 差一点走进世界杯，但成了全民的世界杯
riddle_english: Just missed getting into the World Cup, but became the whole nation’s World Cup.

riddle_original: 一碗甜品，装下了一群年轻人的爱情
riddle_english: A bowl of dessert holds a whole group of young people's love stories.

riddle_original: 我的片尾曲过了十多年了每年还是会听到
riddle_english: My ending theme is more than ten years old, yet you still hear it every year.

riddle_original: 我离开那么多年，每逢佳节还是能在电视上见到我
riddle_english: Even though I’ve been gone for so many years, you can still see me on TV whenever the festive season comes around.

riddle_original: 世界第一没有站上最高领奖台，故事却走进了电影院
riddle_english: Though number one in the world, he never stood on the top podium—yet his story made it to the cinema.

riddle_original: 我要去寻找白由
riddle_english: I’m going to look for Bai You.
riddle_note: 电影台词（主角把“自由”写成“白由”）

riddle_original: 名字看似在讲吃，其实一直在讲政治
riddle_english: The title looks like it’s about food, but it’s really about politics all along.

riddle_original: 想成为马来西亚电影界的金马奖，却只举行过一次
riddle_english: Wanted to become the Golden Horse Awards of Malaysia’s film industry, but was held only once.

riddle_original: 他亲手杀了自己的好友，却成为了忠诚的象征
riddle_english: He killed his own close friend with his own hands, yet became a symbol of loyalty.

riddle_original: 无辜的她被杀了后，流了白色的血，诅咒了一个地方
riddle_english: After the innocent woman was killed, she bled white blood and placed a curse on a place.

riddle_original: 不管老虎还是鳄鱼都只能被我骗
riddle_english: Whether tiger or crocodile, all can only be outwitted by me.

riddle_original: 一般上有四句，但只要理解后两句
riddle_english: It generally has four lines, but you only need to understand the last two.
riddle_note: 马来诗歌

riddle_original: 一个自传型漫画，画出了马来西亚人的童年
riddle_english: An autobiographical comic that depicts the childhood of Malaysians.

riddle_original: 我是真历史，还是假历史？到现在都没有答案
riddle_english: Am I true history or made-up history? To this day, there is still no answer.

riddle_original: 很多人想娶我，但完不成我对他们的考验
riddle_english: Many people want to marry me, but they cannot complete the test I set for them.

riddle_original: 小学生每个月最期待的兄妹
riddle_english: The brother and sister that primary school pupils look forward to most every month

riddle_original: 五个好朋友，我能力排第二；有人说我是叛徒，也有人说我是英雄
riddle_english: Among five close friends, my abilities ranked second; some say I was a traitor, while others say I was a hero.

riddle_original: 小学生每周必读的“报纸”
riddle_english: The “newspaper” every primary school pupil has to read each week

riddle_original: 当代贪官包二奶
riddle_english: A contemporary, corrupted officials keep mistresses.

riddle_original: 红字一到，所有人突然开始认真。
riddle_english: Once the red-letter document arrives, everyone suddenly becomes serious.

riddle_original: 皇帝的新衣
riddle_english: The Emperor's New Clothes
