riddle_english: When you look in your wallet and it's empty, what colour do you see?

riddle_original: Se ce l'hai vivo addosso, sei vivace e pieno di energie.
riddle_english: If you've got it alive on you, you're lively and full of energy.

riddle_original: Questo cibo piace così tanto alla gatta che a furia di ritornarci, prima o poi ci lascerà l'impronta.
riddle_english: The cat likes this food so much that, by dint of returning to it, sooner or later she'll leave her print on it.

riddle_original: Si augura a chi ha una sfida importante, sperando che finisca dritto tra i denti di un predatore dei boschi.
riddle_english: It is wished upon those facing an important challenge, hoping they end up straight between the teeth of a woodland predator.

riddle_original: Devi tenerla tra le labbra se vuoi che un segreto non scappi via, ma guai a deglutire.
riddle_english: You must hold it between your lips if you want a secret not to escape, but heaven forbid you swallow.

riddle_original: È quell'immensa distesa d'acqua che separa chi chiacchiera da chi realizza le cose.
riddle_english: It is that immense expanse of water that separates the one who chatters from the one who gets things done.

riddle_original: Indica l'abbondanza che arriva a chi non ne ha bisogno, come se il cielo decidesse di versare acqua solo su chi è già completamente fradicio.
riddle_english: It indicates abundance arriving for someone who doesn't need it, as if the sky decided to pour water only on those who are already completely soaked.
reference_answer_english: It rains on the wet one

riddle_original: ヒョウはヒョウでも、動物園にいなくて、選挙の日に箱の中へ集まるヒョウは？
riddle_english: It's a 'hyō', but not one at the zoo — the 'hyō' that gathers inside a box on election day. What is it?
riddle_hint: 選挙の日にみんなが書いて入れるもの
riddle_note: Wordplay: ヒョウ can be 豹 (leopard), 雹 (hail), or 票 (ballot) — all homophones.

riddle_original: カクはカクでも、三角でも四角でもない、総理大臣が作るカクは？
riddle_english: It's a 'kaku', but not a triangle (san-kaku) or square (shi-kaku) — the 'kaku' the prime minister forms. What is it?
riddle_note: Classic「〇〇はNでも」pattern on かく (角/閣).

riddle_original: 「きょ」が千個集まると、国の大事なイベントになる。それは何？
riddle_english: Gather one thousand (sen) 'kyo's and you get an important national event. What is it?
riddle_note: Goroawase: 千 (sen, 1000) + きょ → せんきょ (election).

riddle_original: 畑にありそうな名前なのに、国会で働いているのは？
riddle_english: Its name sounds like it belongs in a vegetable field, yet it works in the National Diet. What is it?
riddle_hint: 「野菜」と同じ漢字が入っている
riddle_note: Kanji play: 野 (field) appears in both 野菜 (vegetable) and 野党 (opposition party).

riddle_original: キンはキンでも、買い物のたびにみんなが少しずつ払っているキンは？
riddle_english: It's a 'kin', and everyone pays a little of it every time they shop. What is it?
riddle_hint: レシートに書いてある
riddle_note: きん pattern (金/菌/筋). Reviewer note: standard rate 10%, reduced 8% — answer kept rate-agnostic.

riddle_original: 日本にはいないのに、日本のニュースにしょっちゅう登場する「大」のつく外国の偉い人は？
riddle_english: Japan doesn't have one, yet this foreign leader with 'dai' in the title is always in the Japanese news. Who?
riddle_hint: 日本のトップは総理大臣
riddle_note: Civics twist: Japan has a prime minister, not a president.

riddle_original: ドウはドウでも、法律が生まれる大きなドウは？
riddle_english: It's a 'dō' — a big one where laws are born. What is it?
riddle_note: どう pattern (道/銅/堂).

riddle_original: ヤクはヤクでも、選挙の前に政治家がたくさんするヤクは？
riddle_english: It's a 'yaku' that politicians make lots of right before an election. What is it?
riddle_note: やく pattern (薬/役/約). Answer 約束 is close but 公約 is the intended political term — accept 約束 at reviewer's discretion.

riddle_original: 「首」という漢字が入っているのに、クビになったら大ニュースになる仕事は？
riddle_english: The kanji for 'neck' (kubi = also 'getting fired') is in the job title, yet if this person is actually fired it's huge news. What job?
riddle_hint: 総理大臣とも呼ばれる
riddle_note: Kanji play: 首 = neck; クビになる is slang for getting fired.

riddle_original: ケツはケツでも、教室でも国会でも使われる、おしりじゃないケツは？
riddle_english: It's a 'ketsu' used in classrooms and in the Diet — and it's not a rear end. What is it?
riddle_hint: 手を挙げて数をかぞえる
riddle_note: けつ is mild slang for buttocks — cheeky but standard register for kids' nazonazo.

riddle_original: 「寒（さむ）い」夜に「雷（らい）」が鳴ると現れる？ちょんまげ頭の昔の戦士は？
riddle_english: On a cold ('SAMU-i') night, when thunder ('RAI') rolls, this topknotted warrior appears. Who is he?
riddle_note: Goroawase construction: さむ(い) + らい(雷) → さむらい.

riddle_original: 壁にはりついたり天井にひそんだり、「いない」ふりが日本一うまい昔の仕事は？
riddle_english: Clinging to walls, lurking in ceilings — Japan's champion at pretending not to exist. What old profession?
riddle_note: Descriptive riddle; no pun.

riddle_original: ブツはブツでも、奈良の大きな建物の中でどっしり座っているブツは？
riddle_english: It's a 'butsu', sitting massively inside a great building in Nara. What is it?
riddle_note: ぶつ pattern (物/仏).

riddle_original: 白いとはかぎらないのに、みんなが「しろ」と呼ぶ昔の建物は？
riddle_english: It isn't always white ('shiro'), yet everyone calls it 'shiro'. What historic building?
riddle_note: Homophones: 白 (white) vs 城 (castle). Reviewer aside: 姫路城 is white, 松本城 is black.

riddle_original: 「火」を「見」て、「子」…をつなげた名前の、占いで国を治めた昔の女王は？
riddle_english: Join 'HI' (fire), 'MI' (see) and 'KO' (child) — an ancient queen who ruled through divination. Who is she?
riddle_note: Syllable construction: ひ(火) + み(見) + こ(子) → ひみこ.

riddle_original: 「絵（え）」に「土（ど）」を混ぜるとできあがる、東京の昔の呼び名は？
riddle_english: Mix 'E' (a picture) with 'DO' (earth) and you get Tokyo's old name. What is it?
riddle_note: Goroawase: え + ど → 江戸.

riddle_original: ドキはドキでも、縄の模様で考古学者をドキドキさせる大昔のドキは？
riddle_english: It's a 'doki' whose rope patterns make archaeologists' hearts go 'doki-doki' (thump). What is it?
riddle_note: Pun: 土器 (doki, earthenware) vs ドキドキ (heart-pounding).

riddle_original: 名前に「休み」が入っているのに、お茶の道をきわめた働き者は？
riddle_english: His name contains the kanji for 'rest', yet he worked tirelessly perfecting the way of tea. Who is he?
riddle_note: Kanji play: 休 (rest) inside 千利休's name.

riddle_original: 「おだ」やかじゃない性格で有名？「うつけ」と呼ばれた戦国武将は？
riddle_english: Famous for a temper that was anything but 'ODA-yaka' (calm) — the warlord once called 'the fool of Owari'. Who?
riddle_hint: 本能寺で最期を迎えた
riddle_note: Pun: おだ(やか) (calm) vs 織田. He was nicknamed 尾張の大うつけ in his youth.

riddle_original: 侍の頭の上で、ちょこんと「曲げ」られている髪型は？
riddle_english: It sits atop a samurai's head, neatly 'bent' ('mage'). What hairstyle is it?
riddle_note: まげ = 曲げ (bent); topknot hairstyle.

riddle_original: 山は山でも、お正月の初夢に出てくるといちばん縁起がいい山は？
riddle_english: A mountain that brings the best luck if it appears in your first dream of the New Year. Which mountain?
riddle_note: Based on the proverb 一富士二鷹三茄子 (lucky first dreams: 1. Fuji, 2. hawk, 3. eggplant).

riddle_original: 楽器の名前なのに、音が鳴らない日本一大きな湖は？
riddle_english: It's named after a musical instrument but makes no sound — Japan's largest lake. What is it?
riddle_note: Named after the biwa (Japanese lute) because of its shape.

riddle_original: ドウはドウでも、歩けないくらい大きくて、雪がたくさん降るドウは？
riddle_english: It's a 'dō' far too big to walk down, where lots of snow falls. What is it?
riddle_note: どう pattern; 道 here is an administrative unit, not a road.

riddle_original: 四角（しかく）にそっくりな名前なのに、四角くない島は？
riddle_english: Its name sounds just like 'square' (shikaku), but it isn't square at all. Which island?
riddle_note: Near-homophone play: しこく (Shikoku) vs しかく (square).

riddle_original: 縄（なわ）は縄でも、跳べないのに泳ぎに行きたくなる縄は？
riddle_english: It's a 'nawa' (rope) you can't jump over — but it makes you want to go swimming. What is it?
riddle_hint: 日本でいちばん南の県
riddle_note: なわ pattern (縄跳び jump rope vs 沖縄 Okinawa).

riddle_original: タマはタマでも、転がらないし、海にも入れないタマは？
riddle_english: It's a 'tama' (ball) that doesn't roll and can never touch the sea. What is it?
riddle_note: Saitama is landlocked — 海なし県 ('no-sea prefecture') is a running joke locals will recognize.

riddle_original: 島が根っこを生やして動けなくなった…そんな名前の県は？
riddle_english: An island grew roots and couldn't move — which prefecture has that name?
riddle_note: Literal kanji reading of 島根: island + root.

riddle_original: ミチはミチでも、地図には描いてあるのに誰も歩けない、地球でいちばん暑いミチは？
riddle_english: It's a 'michi' (road) drawn on every map, yet nobody can walk it — the hottest one on Earth. What is it?
riddle_hint: 地球のまんなかをぐるり
riddle_note: みち pattern; 赤道 (equator) is written with 道 (road) but is not walkable.

riddle_original: 島は島でも、半分だけ陸にくっついて離れられない島は？
riddle_english: It's an island — but only half of one, clinging to the mainland, unable to leave. What is it?
riddle_note: Literal kanji play: 半島 = half + island.

riddle_original: ズはズでも、世界中を小さくたたんでカバンに入れられるズは？
riddle_english: It's a 'zu' that folds the whole world small enough to fit in your bag. What is it?
riddle_note: ず pattern (図).

riddle_original: カブはカブでも、畑では育たずに、白い顔で「見得」を切るカブは？
riddle_english: It's a 'kabu' (turnip), but it doesn't grow in a field — it strikes dramatic poses with a white-painted face. What is it?
riddle_hint: 隈取という化粧をする
riddle_note: かぶ pattern (蕪 turnip / 株 stock) vs 歌舞伎; 見得 = the frozen dramatic pose.

riddle_original: ツルはツルでも、鳥じゃないのに、一枚の紙から生まれるツルは？
riddle_english: It's a 'tsuru' (crane), but not a bird — it's born from a single sheet of paper. What is it?
riddle_hint: 千羽集めると願いがかなうと言われる
riddle_note: つる pattern (鶴/蔓/釣る); the 千羽鶴 tradition of folding a thousand for a wish.

riddle_original: たった17音しかないのに、季節をまるごと閉じこめられる世界一短い詩は？
riddle_english: Only seventeen sounds long, yet it can hold a whole season inside — the world's shortest poem. What is it?
riddle_note: The 季語 (season word) requirement is the 'season inside' clue; 17 on = 5-7-5.

riddle_original: エはエでも、江戸時代に何枚も刷られて、大きな波とお富士さんで世界的に有名になったエは？
riddle_english: It's an 'e' (picture), printed sheet after sheet in the Edo period — world-famous for a great wave and Mt. Fuji. What is it?
riddle_note: え pattern; woodblock printing = mass-produced art; Hokusai's Great Wave off Kanagawa.

riddle_original: ドンドンたたかれても、怒るどころかお祭りでいちばん大きな声を出して喜ぶのは？
riddle_english: It gets pounded and pounded, yet far from getting angry, it cheers loudest of all at the festival. What is it?
riddle_note: Personification riddle; taiko at festivals and bon-odori.

riddle_original: スミはスミでも、部屋のすみっこじゃなくて、筆と一緒に白い紙の上で踊るスミを使う芸術は？
riddle_english: It's a 'sumi' — not the corner of a room — the kind that dances across white paper with a brush. What art uses it?
riddle_hint: お正月には「書き初め」をする
riddle_note: すみ homophones: 隅 (corner) vs 墨 (ink). Accept 習字 as well as 書道.

riddle_original: 花は切られてしまったのに、前よりきれいに「生き」かえる芸術は？
riddle_english: The flowers have been cut, yet they come back to 'life' more beautiful than before. What art is this?
riddle_hint: 剣山に挿して形をつくる
riddle_note: Kanji play: 生ける means 'to arrange (flowers)' and contains 生 (life).

riddle_original: 座布団から一歩も動かないのに、一人で何人もの役を演じ分けて、最後に「オチ」を落とす芸は？
riddle_english: Never moving from the cushion, one performer becomes many people — and drops a punchline ('ochi') at the end. What art is this?
riddle_hint: 小道具は扇子と手ぬぐいだけ
riddle_note: 落語の「落」= オチ (punchline); props limited to a fan and a hand towel.

riddle_original: ガはガでも、羽がないのに世界中へ飛んでいく、日本生まれのガは？
riddle_english: It's a 'ga' (moth) with no wings, yet it flies all over the world — born in Japan. What is it?
riddle_hint: コマとふきだしでお話が進む
riddle_note: が pattern (蛾 moth vs 画/漫画); manga's global reach.

riddle_original: 泣く場面でも笑う場面でも、役者の本当の顔は見せない、木でできたもう一つの顔は？
riddle_english: In sad scenes and happy ones alike, the actor's real face never shows — a second face carved from wood. What is it?
riddle_note: The angle changes the expression (照らす/曇らす) — the paradox that a fixed mask can 'cry and laugh'.

riddle_original: 土俵の上で塩をまくのに、料理は始めない大きな人は？
riddle_english: He scatters salt over the ring — but never starts cooking. Who is he?
riddle_note: Sumo salt-purification ritual; either 力士 or お相撲さん is correct.

riddle_original: キュウはキュウでも、9人で追いかけるキュウは？
riddle_english: It's a 'kyū' (ball) chased by nine ('kyū') players. What sport is it?
riddle_note: Double goroawase: 球 (きゅう, ball) = 9 (きゅう); baseball fields 9 players.

riddle_original: 手を使うと怒られるのに、ひとりだけ使っても許される人がいるスポーツは？
riddle_english: Using your hands gets you in trouble — except for exactly one player. What sport is it?
riddle_hint: そのひとりはキーパー
riddle_note: Descriptive riddle on the goalkeeper exception.

riddle_original: タマはタマでも、ひもにつながれて遠くへ飛べないタマは？
riddle_english: It's a 'tama' (ball) tied to a string, so it can never fly far. What is it?
riddle_note: たま pattern; traditional toy.

riddle_original: 見つかったら負けなのに、最後まで見つからないとちょっと寂しい遊びは？
riddle_english: If you're found, you lose — but never being found at all feels a little lonely. What game is it?
riddle_note: Observational riddle on hide-and-seek's paradox.

riddle_original: グーで勝ってもパンチじゃない、声と手だけの一瞬の勝負は？
riddle_english: You can win with 'gū' (a fist), but it's not a punch — a one-second battle of voice and hands. What is it?
riddle_note: グー doubles as rock-paper-scissors 'rock' and a fist.

riddle_original: 自分は跳ばずにぐるぐる回って、引っかかった人を止めちゃうのは？
riddle_english: It never jumps itself — it just spins round and round, and stops anyone it catches. What is it?
riddle_note: Perspective flip: the rope, not the jumper.

riddle_original: ソンはソンでも、走りきると大きな得した気分になるソンは？
riddle_english: It ends in 'son' (= loss), yet finishing it feels like a huge gain. What race is it?
riddle_note: Pun: ソン = 損 (loss), inverted by 得 (gain).

riddle_original: 取った敵の駒が、こんどは自分の味方になる盤上の戦いは？
riddle_english: Captured enemy pieces switch sides and fight for you. What board game is it?
riddle_hint: 王様を詰ませたら勝ち
riddle_note: The piece-drop rule is unique to shogi among chess-family games.

riddle_original: ジュウはジュウでも、数字の10じゃなくて「柔らかい」ジュウのスポーツは？
riddle_english: It's a 'jū' — not the number ten, but the 'gentle' kind. What sport is it?
riddle_note: Homophones: 十 (10) vs 柔 (gentle/soft).

riddle_original: キンはキンでも、京都の池のほとりで、建物ぜんぶがピカピカ光っているキンは？
riddle_english: It's a 'kin' (gold) — a whole building glittering beside a pond in Kyoto. What is it?
riddle_note: きん pattern (also used in #5 — a signature pattern of the set); gold-leaf pavilion, part of Kyoto's World Heritage listing.

riddle_original: トリはトリでも、飛べないのに海の上に立っている、大きな赤いトリは？
riddle_english: It's a 'tori' (bird) that cannot fly, yet it stands in the sea — huge and red. What is it?
reference_answer_english: The great torii of Itsukushima Shrine
riddle_note: とり pattern (鳥 bird vs 鳥居 torii); the 'floating' great gate of Itsukushima Shrine at high tide.

riddle_original: 屋根が「手を合わせて」お祈りしている形をした、雪国の世界遺産の村は？
riddle_english: A World Heritage village in snow country, where the roofs press their 'hands together' in prayer. Which village?
riddle_note: 合掌造り = 'praying-hands construction'; the steep thatched roofs shed heavy snow.

riddle_original: おじぎをすると、おじぎを返してくれる、奈良公園の礼儀正しい住民は？
riddle_english: Bow to them and they bow right back — the well-mannered residents of Nara Park. Who are they?
riddle_note: The deer are a protected natural monument; they famously 'bow' for shika-senbei.

riddle_original: 「見ない・言わない・聞かない」の約束を、日光で400年も守り続けている3匹は？
riddle_english: For 400 years in Nikkō, these three have kept their promise: see nothing, say nothing, hear nothing. Who are they?
reference_answer_english: The three wise monkeys (of Nikkō Tōshō-gū)
riddle_hint: 目・口・耳を手でふさいでいる
riddle_note: 見ざる言わざる聞かざる — ~ざる doubles as 猿 (saru, monkey); carving at Nikkō Tōshō-gū.

riddle_original: 「おじいちゃん」なんてものじゃない、数千年生きている大きな杉が主の、鹿児島の島は？
riddle_english: Way more than a 'grandpa' — a giant cedar thousands of years old rules this island in Kagoshima. Which island?
riddle_note: Yakushima, Japan's first natural World Heritage site (1993); Jōmon-sugi age estimates range 2,000-7,000+ years.

riddle_original: カミはカミでも、神社にいるカミじゃなくて、「千年もつ」と言われるカミは？
riddle_english: It's a 'kami' — not the god enshrined at a shrine — the kind said to last a thousand years. What is it?
riddle_note: かみ homophones (神 god / 髪 hair / 紙 paper); washi joined the UNESCO intangible heritage list in 2014.

riddle_original: 料理なのに「季節を器にのせる」と言われて、無形文化遺産にまで登録された日本の食文化は？
riddle_english: A cuisine said to 'serve the seasons on the plate' — registered as intangible cultural heritage. What is it?
riddle_note: Washoku, UNESCO intangible cultural heritage since 2013.

riddle_original: 渡らずに、股の間から逆さまにのぞいて見るのが正解と言われる、天まで届きそうな橋は？
riddle_english: A 'bridge' you're not meant to cross — the proper way to view it, they say, is upside down through your own legs. What is it?
riddle_hint: 京都府にある日本三景のひとつ
riddle_note: Amanohashidate ('bridge to heaven'), one of the 日本三景 (Three Views of Japan) and a Special Place of Scenic Beauty; the 股のぞき (peering through one's legs) custom flips the pine-covered sandbar into a bridge across the sky.

riddle_original: 世界でいちばん古い木造建築なのに、1400年たった今も奈良でしゃんと立っているお寺は？
riddle_english: The world's oldest wooden buildings — still standing straight in Nara after 1,400 years. What temple?
riddle_hint: 聖徳太子が建てたと伝わる
riddle_note: Hōryū-ji (five-story pagoda and kondō); listed alongside Himeji in Japan's first World Heritage batch.

riddle_original: 1年生から6年生まで、6年間ずっと背中にくっついて学校へ通う、四角い相棒は？
riddle_english: From first grade to sixth, it rides on your back to school for six whole years — a boxy little partner. What is it?
riddle_hint: 入学のときに買ってもらう
riddle_note: Randoseru are built to last all six years of elementary school; colors have diversified beyond red/black.

riddle_original: レストランじゃないのに、白い服を着た当番が配ってくれて、みんなで「いただきます」を言ってから食べる昼ごはんは？
riddle_english: It's not a restaurant, yet servers in white coats bring the food, and everyone says 'itadakimasu' together before eating. What lunch is this?
riddle_hint: 献立表が毎月配られる
riddle_note: 給食当番 (lunch duty) — the students themselves serve; a distinctive feature of Japanese schools.

riddle_original: タマはタマでも、投げたり転がしたりしちゃいけない、お正月にポチ袋でもらうタマは？
riddle_english: It's a 'tama' (ball) you must never throw or roll — you get it at New Year's in a little envelope. What is it?
riddle_note: たま pattern (also #26/#44 — signature pattern); otoshidama from parents and relatives.

riddle_original: サカナはサカナでも、水の中では泳がずに、5月の空を泳ぐサカナは？
riddle_english: It's a fish that never swims in water — it swims in the May sky instead. What is it?
riddle_note: Carp streamers for Children's Day (May 5); carp symbolize success (the waterfall-climbing legend).

riddle_original: 3歳・5歳・7歳のときだけ、着物を着て神社へ行って、長〜い飴をもらえる特別な日は？
riddle_english: Only at ages three, five, and seven: you wear a kimono, visit the shrine, and receive a looong stick of candy. What special day?
riddle_note: Shichi-go-san (Nov 15); chitose-ame ('thousand-year candy') symbolizes long life.

riddle_original: 夏休みの朝、眠い目をこすって公園に集まって、音楽に合わせて体を動かすとスタンプが1個もらえるのは？
riddle_english: On summer-vacation mornings you gather in the park rubbing sleepy eyes, move along with the music — and earn one stamp. What is it?
riddle_note: Radio calisthenics with attendance stamp cards — a summer-vacation institution since 1928 (participation declining in some areas — mild generation note).

riddle_original: 学校の中でだけはいて、金曜日にはおうちに連れて帰って洗ってもらう白い靴は？
riddle_english: Shoes worn only inside the school building — taken home on Fridays for a wash. What are they?
riddle_hint: 昇降口の靴箱で外靴と交代する
riddle_note: Uwabaki; extends the inside/outside (genkan) distinction to schools — pairs with #77.

riddle_original: 抜けたら「屋根の上」か「縁の下」に投げると、次のが丈夫に生えてくると言われるものは？
riddle_english: When it comes out, you throw it onto the roof or under the floor so the next one grows in strong. What is it?
riddle_hint: 下の歯は屋根の上へ、上の歯は縁の下へ
riddle_note: Traditional custom (the new tooth grows toward where the old one was thrown); harder to practice in apartments — mild housing/generation specificity.

riddle_original: 赤と白に分かれて、玉を投げたり綱を引いたり、家族もお弁当を持って応援に来る、学校の大きなイベントは？
riddle_english: Split into red and white teams, you toss beanbags and tug ropes while families cheer with boxed lunches. What big school event is this?
riddle_note: Undōkai; the red-white team division traces back to Genpei War banner colors.

riddle_original: 遠足の前の日に窓のそばにつるされて、「あした天気にしておくれ」とお願いされる白い子は？
riddle_english: The night before a school trip, this little white fellow is hung by the window and begged: 'make tomorrow sunny, please!' What is it?
riddle_hint: ティッシュやハンカチで作る
riddle_note: Teru-teru bōzu; the request line quotes the well-known children's song.

riddle_original: 雨の日は大活躍、晴れた日は忘れられて、電車に置き去りにされがちなものは？
riddle_english: A hero on rainy days, forgotten on sunny ones — and so often left behind on trains. What is it?
riddle_note: Umbrellas are the #1 lost item on Japanese trains — culturally resonant.

riddle_original: トンはトンでも、ブタじゃないのに毎晩あなたを寝かせてくれるトンは？
riddle_english: It's a 'ton' — not a pig ('ton') — yet it tucks you in every night. What is it?
riddle_note: とん pattern (豚 vs 団).

riddle_original: あなたの真似ばかりするのに、絶対に謝らない相手は？
riddle_english: It copies everything you do, but never once apologizes. Who is it?
riddle_note: Mirror riddles are a universal folk motif; phrasing original.

riddle_original: コはコでも、ドアを開けられるたびに「寒い寒い」と震えていそうなコは？
riddle_english: It's a 'ko' that seems to shiver 'cold, cold!' every time its door is opened. What is it?
riddle_note: こ pattern; the fridge is the cold one.

riddle_original: 服をぐるぐる回して遊んでいるように見えて、本当は一生けんめい働いている機械は？
riddle_english: It looks like it's playing, spinning clothes round and round — but really it's working hard. What machine?
riddle_note: Descriptive riddle.

riddle_original: 2本そろわないと仕事にならない、食卓の名コンビは？
riddle_english: They can't do their job unless both show up — the dinner table's famous duo. What are they?
riddle_note: はし homophones (橋 bridge / 端 edge) can be a bonus discussion point.

riddle_original: 家の中なのに、靴を脱ぐまでは「外」あつかいされる場所は？
riddle_english: It's inside the house, yet treated as 'outside' until you take off your shoes. What place is it?
riddle_note: The genkan as an inside/outside threshold — distinctly Japanese spatial concept.

riddle_original: 食いしんぼうなのに、ゴミしか食べさせてもらえない機械は？
riddle_english: A big eater that only ever gets fed garbage. What machine is it?
riddle_hint: スイッチを入れると吸い込む
riddle_note: Personification riddle.

riddle_original: 毎日見つめられているのに、月に一度しかめくってもらえないものは？
riddle_english: It gets stared at every day, but only turned once a month. What is it?
riddle_note: Monthly wall calendars remain common in Japanese homes.

riddle_original: ハリはハリでも、ちくっと刺さらないのに、みんなが一日中気にするハリは？
riddle_english: It's a 'hari' (needle) that never pricks anyone, yet everyone keeps checking it all day. What is it?
riddle_note: はり homophones (針 needle / 張り). Accept 時計 or 針.

riddle_original: 冬になると、コンビニのレジ横で温泉に入っている食べ物は？
riddle_english: In winter, this food soaks in a 'hot spring' right next to the konbini register. What is it?
riddle_note: The open oden pot by the register is a winter konbini icon.

riddle_original: マンはマンでも、寒い日にコンビニで湯気を立てて待っているマンは？
riddle_english: It's a 'man' waiting in a cloud of steam at the konbini on cold days. What is it?
riddle_hint: あんまん、ピザまんも仲間
riddle_note: まん pattern; the steamer case by the register.

riddle_original: 昔はタダでもらえたのに、今は「3円です」と言われるものは？
riddle_english: It used to be free — now they say, 'that will be 3 yen'. What is it?
riddle_note: Plastic-bag charging became mandatory July 2020; price varies by store (3-5 yen typical).

riddle_original: カードはカードでも、レジで毎回「お持ちですか？」と聞かれるカードは？
riddle_english: It's a card the cashier asks about every single time: 'Do you have one?' What is it?
riddle_hint: 貯めると割引やクーポン
riddle_note: The universal register phrase「ポイントカードはお持ちですか」— instantly recognizable.

riddle_original: パリパリのために、食べる直前まで離ればなれにされている2人は？
riddle_english: Two friends kept apart until the very moment you eat — all for the sake of crispiness. Who are they?
reference_answer_english: The onigiri and its nori (in the separated film wrapper)
riddle_hint: フィルムを引っぱってはがす
riddle_note: The separated-nori film wrapper — konbini engineering to keep nori crisp.

riddle_original: 銀行じゃないのに電気代が払えて、郵便局じゃないのに荷物が送れるお店は？
riddle_english: Not a bank, yet you can pay your electric bill; not a post office, yet you can ship a parcel. What store?
riddle_note: Konbini as social infrastructure (bill payment, parcels, ATM).

riddle_original: 毎週火曜日、コンビニの棚にやってくる「新人さん」は？
riddle_english: The 'new hires' that show up on konbini shelves every Tuesday. What are they?
riddle_hint: 新作スイーツやおにぎり
riddle_note: New products typically land Tuesdays; exact day can vary by chain — reviewer may soften to 「毎週」.

riddle_original: コンビニの隅で、紙を食べては紙を吐き出している働き者は？
riddle_english: In the corner of the konbini, a hard worker that eats paper and spits out paper. What is it?
riddle_note: Multi-copy machines print residence certificates, tickets, photos.

riddle_original: レジ横のガラスケースから、いいにおいで誘惑してくるのは？
riddle_english: It tempts you with delicious smells from the glass case beside the register. What is it?
reference_answer_original: からあげ（ホットスナック）
riddle_hint: 各チェーンに看板商品がある
riddle_note: Hot snack case (e.g., fried chicken); brand names deliberately avoided in the answer.

riddle_original: 同じおにぎりなのに、ここで食べると税金がちょっと高くなる場所は？
riddle_english: Same onigiri — but eat it here, and the tax gets a little higher. What is this place?
reference_answer_english: The eat-in corner (10% tax vs 8% takeout)
riddle_note: Reduced tax-rate rule: 8% takeout vs 10% eat-in — a uniquely Japanese checkout question since 2019.

riddle_original: 湯船に入る前にする、お湯への「ごあいさつ」は？
riddle_english: The polite 'greeting' you give the bath water before getting in. What is it?
reference_answer_english: Kakeyu (rinsing yourself before entering the bath)
riddle_note: Etiquette: rinse before entering the shared bath.

riddle_original: 湯船の中では、体を拭くためじゃなく頭にのせるためにあるものは？
riddle_english: In the bathtub, it belongs on your head — not on your body. What is it?
reference_answer_english: A towel (kept out of the water, folded on the head)
riddle_hint: お湯につけないのがマナー
riddle_note: Towel-on-head custom; towels must not touch the bathwater.

riddle_original: お風呂上がりに、腰に手を当ててぐいっと飲むものは？
riddle_english: After the bath, you drink it in one go — with one hand planted on your hip. What is it?
reference_answer_english: Coffee milk (the classic bottled post-bath drink)
riddle_hint: フルーツ牛乳派もいる
riddle_note: Iconic post-bath pose. Accept フルーツ牛乳 or 瓶の牛乳 as answers.

riddle_original: くぐった瞬間に、男と女に分かれてしまう布は？
riddle_english: The moment you pass through this cloth, men and women part ways. What is it?
riddle_note: Split noren curtains at the changing-room entrance.

riddle_original: 銭湯の壁いっぱいに広がって、湯船につかりながら旅気分にさせてくれる大きな絵は？
riddle_english: It spreads across the entire sento wall, making you feel like a traveler while you soak. What is it?
riddle_note: The hand-painted sento mural tradition (esp. Tokyo-style); Mt. Fuji is the classic subject — moved to the hint so the answer no longer duplicates #21. Only a handful of professional sento mural painters remain.

riddle_original: 銭湯でお客さんより高いところに座っている、お金を受け取る人の席は？
riddle_english: The seat higher than any customer, where the entrance fee is collected. What is it?
riddle_note: The raised attendant's seat; declining in modern sento — a nostalgia marker.

riddle_original: お湯なのに、大きな板で「もまれて」冷まされる温泉の伝統は？
riddle_english: It's hot spring water that gets 'kneaded' with big wooden paddles to cool it down. What tradition is this?
riddle_hint: 「草津よいとこ〜」の歌と一緒に
riddle_note: Regional: Kusatsu Onsen (Gunma Pref.) tradition of cooling very hot spring water with wooden paddles, sung to 草津節.

riddle_original: フロはフロでも、お空や星と一緒に入るフロは？
riddle_english: It's a 'furo' (bath) you share with the sky and the stars. What is it?
riddle_note: ふろ pattern; open-air bath.

riddle_original: 温泉に長く入りすぎて、中までとろとろになっちゃったのは？
riddle_english: It stayed in the hot spring so long, it went soft and silky all the way through. What is it?
riddle_note: Onsen tamago: slow-cooked egg in spring water.

riddle_original: 熱いサウナと冷たい水風呂を行ったり来たりした人が、最後に言う魔法の言葉は？
riddle_english: The magic word people say after going back and forth between the hot sauna and the cold plunge. What is it?
reference_answer_english: 'Totonou' (lit. 'to come into alignment' — sauna slang for the euphoric reset)
riddle_hint: サウナブームの流行語
riddle_note: Modern sauna slang (post-2019 boom). Answer is an expression, not a noun — flag for reviewer; swap out if the project requires noun answers.

riddle_original: ಮದುವೆ ಆಗಲಿಲ್ಲ, ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಹೆರೋದು ತಪ್ಪಲಿಲ್ಲ; ಹಸು-ಕರು ಕಟ್ಟಲಿಲ್ಲ, ಹಾಲು ಕುಡಿಯೋದು ತಪ್ಪಲಿಲ್ಲ; ಸ್ವಂತ ಮನೆ ಕಟ್ಟಲಿಲ್ಲ, ಕಟ್ಟಿದ ಮನೆ ಬಿಡಲಿಲ್ಲ; ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಮಲಗಲಿಲ್ಲ, ಅಟ್ಟ ಬಿಡಲಿಲ್ಲ. ಈ ಭಾಗ್ಯವಂತರು ಯಾರು?
riddle_english: They never married but still had children; never tied a cow or calf but still drank milk; never built their own house but never left a built house; never slept on the ground but never left the loft. Who are these fortunate ones?

riddle_original: ಸುತ್ತಿಸುತ್ತಿ ಬರ್ತೀ ನನಗಾಗಿ, ಮೇಲೊಬ್ಬ ಕೂತವ್ನೆ ನಿನಗಾಗಿ ನಿನ್
riddle_english: I circle around for you; someone sits above for you; my life is destroyed by you, and I end up neatly in the basket.

riddle_original: ಸೊಂಡಿಲ ಮೂಗಿನ ರಾಜಕುಮಾರಿ, ಬಣ್ಣದ ಬೆಡಗಿನ ಸಿಂಗಾರಿ; ಹೂವಕ್ಕನ ಪಾಯಸ ಹೀರಿ, ಗಕ್ಕನೆ ಹಾರು ಯಾರೀ ನಾರಿ?
riddle_english: A trunk-nosed princess, colorful and beautiful; she drinks nectar from the flower-sister and suddenly flies away. Who is she?

riddle_original: ಅಗಣಿ ಮರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೆಂಚಪ್ಪ ಡಾಕ್ಟ್ರು ಕುಂತವ್ನೆ, ಹಾಕ್ತಾನೆ ಸೂಜಿ ಮುಟ್ಟಿದೋರ ಕೈಗೆ.
riddle_english: On the agani tree sits red Doctorappa; he gives an injection to the hand of anyone who touches him.

riddle_original: ನಾಗಾಲಮ್ಮ ಗುಡ್ಡ ಏರಿ ಚಿಗುರು ಕೊಯ್ತಾಳೆ.
riddle_english: Nagalamma climbs the hill and cuts the shoots.

riddle_original: ಆಲಿಕಲ್ಲು ಮಳೆಯೊಯ್ದು, ಆನೇಕಲ್
riddle_english: Hail-rain fell, Anekal lake filled, and four sisters crossing the bund returned without getting wet.

riddle_original: ಆರುಕಾಲು ಅಪ್ಪಣ್ಣ ಬಡಿಯೋಕ್ಹೋದ್ರೆ ಹಾರಣ್ಣ, ಕೂತು ಮೀಸೆ ತಿರುವಣ್ಣ
riddle_english: Six-legged Appanna flies when you try to hit him; when he sits, he twirls his moustache.

riddle_original: ಗಿರಿರಾಜನ ಮಗಳ ಗಂಡನ ಹಿರಿಮಗನ ಸಹೋದರನ ವಾಹನ. ಈ ವಾಹನ ಯಾವುದು?
riddle_english: The vehicle of the brother of the eldest son of the husband of the mountain king's daughter. Which vehicle is it?

riddle_original: ಚೋಟುದ್ದ ಲಿಂಗಣ್ಣ ಅಂಗಿ ಬಿಚ್ಚಿ ನುಂಗಣ್ಣ
riddle_english: Short Linganna removes his shirt and is swallowed.

riddle_original: ಅಂಕು ಡೊಂಕು ಹಾವಲ್ಲ, ಮೂತಿ ಉದ್ದ-ಹೆಗ್ಗಣವಲ್ಲ, ಬೂದಿ ಬಣ್ಣ ಜೋಗಿಯಲ್ಲ; ತೂಗಾಡುವುದುಂಟು-ಉಯ್ಯಾಲೆಯಲ್ಲ; ಹೆಗಲೇರಿ ಬರುತ್ತೆ ಹೋಳಾಗಿ ಹೋಗುತ್ತೆ
riddle_english: Crooked but not a snake; long snout but not a bandicoot; ash-colored but not a yogi; it swings but is not a swing; it comes on the shoulder and is cut into pieces.

riddle_original: ಇದೊಂದು ಸೌಭಾಗ್ಯದ ಸಂಕೇತ. ಬಗ್ಗಿದರೆ ಬಾಯಿಗೆ ಬಡಿಯುತ್ತೆ; ಎದ್ದರೆ ಎದೆಗೆ ಬಡಿಯುತ್ತೆ.
riddle_english: It is a sign of good fortune. When it bends it hits the mouth; when it rises it hits the chest.

riddle_original: ಬಾ ಎಂದು ಕರೆವರು, ಬಂದುದ ಕಂಡು ಹಿಗ್ಗುವರು, ಮುಂದೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಅಳುವರು, ಕಾಸು ಕೊಟ್ಟು ನಲಿವರು.
riddle_english: They call her to come; they rejoice when she comes; sitting in front, they cry; after paying money, they rejoice.

riddle_original: ಅಕ್ಕನ ಕೈಗೆ ಪಚ್ಚೆ ಕಡಗ; ಹಾಕುವವರುಂಟು, ತೆಗೆಯುವವರಿಲ್ಲ
riddle_english: A green bangle on elder sister's hand; there are people to put it on, but none to take it off.

riddle_original: ಅರ್ಧ ಏರಿದಾಗ ಅಳುಮೋರೆ, ಪೂರಾ ಏರಿದಾಗ ನಗುಮೋರೆ
riddle_english: Halfway up it makes a crying face; fully up it makes a smiling face.

riddle_original: ಅಂತರಿಕ್ಷದಲ್ಲಾಡೋ ಗಿಡುವ ಭೂಲೋಕದ ಹೆಣ್ಣು, ಬೆಂದ ಬೆಣ್ಣೆ- ಇವು ಮೂರು ಕೂಡಿ ಆಡಿದರೆ ಓಕುಳಿ
riddle_english: A plant dancing in the sky, an earthly woman, and cooked butter: when these three join, there is a splash of color.

riddle_original: ಅಂಗಡೀಲಿ ಮಾರೋದಲ್ಲ, ತಕ್ಕಡೀಲಿ ತೂಗೋದಲ್ಲ; ಪಚ್ಚಕ್ಕನಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಅಂಗಳ ಬೆಳಗೋದಿಲ್ಲ, ಹಬ್ಬ ಸಾಗೋದಿಲ್ಲ.
riddle_english: Not sold in the shop, not weighed on a scale; without green sister the courtyard does not shine and the festival does not proceed.

riddle_original: ಅಮ್ಮಯ್ಯನ ತೋಟಕ್ಕೆ ಬೇಲಿ ಹಾಕಿದ್ದು ಅಪ್ಪಯ್ಯ, ಬೇಲಿ ಕಿತ್ತದ್ದು ಜವರಯ್ಯ.
riddle_english: Father fenced mother's garden; Javara removed the fence.

riddle_original: ನೋಡುವುದು ಮುಂಗೈ, ನುಂಗುವುದು ಹಸ್ತ
riddle_english: Seen at the wrist, swallowed by the palm.

riddle_original: ಅರ್ಧ ಚಂದ್ರಮನಂತೆ ಆಕಾರವಿಹುದು, ಒತ್ತಿ ಮುತ್ತನಿತ್ತರೆ ಗದ್ದರಿಸುತಿಹುದು, ಮುದದಿ ಮೊಳಗುವುದು, ನೀಲಾಂಬರಿಯ ಕಂಡು; ಇನಿಯ ನೀನಿದ ಬಿಡಿದರುಂಟು ಸನಿಹ.
riddle_english: It has the shape of a half moon; press and kiss it and it roars; it rings sweetly under the blue sky; beloved, keep it close.

riddle_original: ಕೋಲಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಡಿದ ಹೂವು ಕೊಲ್ಲೂರಿಗೆ ಹೋಗಿ ಬಂದರೂ ಬಾಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ; ಹೊಂಬಣ್ಣದ ಈ ಹೂವು ತೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುವುದಲ್ಲ, ಸಂತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾರುವುದಲ್ಲ.
riddle_english: A flower worn in Kolar goes to Kollur and back without fading; this golden flower is neither grown in a garden nor sold in a market.

riddle_original: ಅಕ್ಕ ತಂಗಿಯ ಮನೆಗೆ ಹೋಗುವಂತಿಲ್ಲ; ತಂಗಿ ಅಕ್ಕನ ಮನೆಗೆ ಹೋಗುವಂತಿಲ್ಲ; ಆದರೆ, ಅವರಿಬ್ಬರೂ ನೆರೆಹೊರೆಯವರು.
riddle_english: The elder sister cannot go to the younger one's house; the younger cannot go to the elder one's house, yet they are neighbors.

riddle_original: ಅಟ್ಟರೆ ಉರಿಯೊಲ್ಲ, ಸುಟ್ಟರೆ ಬೇಯೊಲ್ಲ.
riddle_english: If beaten it will not burn; if burnt it will not cook.

riddle_original: ಅಂಕು ಡೊಂಕಾದ ಬಾವಿ, ಶಂಖ-ಚಕ್ರ ಬಾವಿ, ಇಣಕಿ ನೋಡಿದರೆ ನೀರಿಲ್ಲ.
riddle_english: A crooked well, a conch-and-disc well; peek inside and there is no water.

riddle_original: ಕೌಮಾರ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಿಡಿಗಾಯಿ, ಯೌವನದಲ್ಲಿ ದೋರುಗಾಯಿ, ಪ್ರೌಢಾವಸ್ಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾಲುಗಾರಿ, ಮುಪ್ಪಿನಲಿ ಹಣ್ಣುಗಾಯಿ
riddle_english: In maidenhood it is a tender fruit, in youth a ripe-green fruit, in adulthood milky, in old age a fruit.

riddle_original: ಎದುರು ಮಾಡದಾಗ ಮೂವತ್ತೆರಡು ಕವಡಿ ಬಿದ್ದಾವ; ತಗೋಬೇಕೆಂದರೆ ಬರೋದಿಲ್ಲ
riddle_english: When facing you, thirty-two cowries are visible; when you try to take them, they do not come.

riddle_original: ಕಲಿತ ಹೈದ ಬಟ್ಟೇಲಿ ಬಂದೋಬಸ್ತ್
riddle_english: The educated boy secures it in cloth; the village boy takes it in hand and throws it away.

riddle_original: ಅಣ್ಣ ತಮ್ಮ ಒಬ್ಬರನ್ನು ಇನ್ನೊಬ್ಬರು ಅಗಲಿ ಇರೋಲ್ಲ, ಆದರೆ ಅಣ್ಣನ ಮನೆಗೆ ತಮ್ಮ ಹೋಗೊಲ್ಲ; ತಮ್ಮನ ಮನೆಗೆ ಅಣ್ಣ ಹೋಗೋಲ್ಲ.
riddle_english: Elder and younger brothers are never apart, yet neither goes to the other's house.

riddle_original: ಊರೆಲ್ಲ ಅಲೆಯೋದು, ಬಾಗಿಲ ಸಂದೀಲಿ ಕೂರೋದು, ಯಾರಿದು?
riddle_english: It wanders through the whole town and sits in the doorway gap. Who is it?

riddle_original: ಮೆನಗೆ ಬಂದವರು ಮೂವರು; ಇಬ್ಬರು ಹೊರಗೆ ನಿಂತರು; ಒಬ್ಬ ಒಳಗೆ ಹೋದ ಹೊರಗೆ ನಿಂತವರು ಯಾರು?
riddle_english: Three came into the house; two stood outside; one went inside. Who are the two outside?

riddle_original: ತಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಾಲವುಂಟು, ಎದೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಣ್ಣುಂಟು, ಸುಲಭದಿ ಕೈ ನುಂಗುವುದುಂಟು, ಹೊಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಲ್ಲುಗಳುಂಟು, ಎಚ್ಚರದಿ ಕಾಯುವುದು ನಮ್ಗಂಟು
riddle_english: It has a tail on its head, an eye on its chest, can easily swallow a hand, has teeth in its belly, and must be guarded carefully.

riddle_original: ಹೊರಗೊಂದು ಕೋಟೆ; ಒಳಗೊಂದು ಕೋಟೆ; ಅದರೊಳಗೊಂದು ಬಿಳಿಹರಳು; ಆದರದು ಮಾಣಿಕ್ಯವಲ್ಲ, ಅದರ ಕಿಮ್ಮತ್ತು ಕಡಿಮೇಯೇನಿಲ್ಲ.
riddle_english: A fort outside, a fort inside; within it a white stone, not a ruby, yet no less precious.

riddle_original: ಮರದ ಪೆಟ್ಟಿಗೆ; ಅದರೊಳಗೊಂದು ಬೆಳ್ಳಿ ಚೆಂಬು, ಅದರ ತುಂಬಾ ಕಾಶಿ ಗಂಗೆ.
riddle_english: A wooden box; inside it a silver pot, and inside that, sacred Ganga water.

riddle_original: ಅಟ್ಟರೆ ಅಡಿಗೆ, ಬಿಟ್ಟರೆ ಬಡಿಗೆ
riddle_english: If beaten it is cooking; if released it is a stick.

riddle_original: ಜಲಜಾಕ್ಷಿಯ ಛತ್ರಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಮಳೆ ಸುರಿದರೂ ನೆನೆಯುವುದಿಲ್ಲ
riddle_english: Lotus-eyed lady's umbrella never gets wet, however much it rains.

riddle_original: ಅರಣ್ಯದಾಗಿರೋ ಗಿಡಗೋವಿಂದ ನಿಂಗ್ಯಾರಿಟ್ಟರೋ ಸಾದಿನ ಬಟ್ಟು?
riddle_english: O Govinda plant in the forest, who gave you the dotted mark?

riddle_original: ಎಲೆ ಹಾಕು ಊಟಕ್ಕೆ ಬಡಿಸಿ, ಎಲೆ ತೆಗೆದು ಉಣ್ಣು ಅಂತಾರೆ!
riddle_english: They say: put the leaf, serve the meal, then remove the leaf and eat!

riddle_original: ದುಡ್ಡು ಕೊಟ್ಟು ತರೋದು, ಮುಂದು ಕೂತು ಅಳೋದು
riddle_english: Bought with money, then one sits in front and cries.

riddle_original: ತಾಮ್ರದ ತಂಬಿಗೆ, ತಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಗುಂಜು, ನೆತ್ತೀಲಿ ಕೊಂಬು.
riddle_english: A copper pot, a lump at the bottom, and a horn on the head.

riddle_original: ಮರದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಬೆಳೆ, ಬಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಬೆಳೆ, ಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಬೆಳೆ; ಒಂದೇ ಕಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದೇ ಹೊತ್ನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಕ್ಕಣೆ.
riddle_english: One crop from a tree, one from a vine, one from stone; all are threshed together in one mouth at one time.

riddle_original: ಉತ್ತಿದ್ದಿಲ್ಲ, ಬಿತ್ತಿದ್ದಿಲ್ಲ; ಕಣ ಮಾಡಲಿಲ್ಲ, ರಾಶಿ ಒಕ್ಕಲಿಲ್ಲ; ಮೆಟ್ಟು ಹತ್ತಲಿಲ್ಲ, ಕಾಳು ತೂರಲಿಲ್ಲ; ಜರಡಿ ಹಿಡೀಲಿಲ್ಲ, ಕಣಜ ತುಂಬಲಿಲ್ಲ; ಬಲೆ ಬೀಸಲಿಲ್ಲ, ಮಿಗ ಹಿಡೀಲಿಲ್ಲ, ಪುಟ್ಟೀಲಿ ತುಂಬಿ ಹೊತ್ತು ಮಾರಿದರೆ ಬೇಡವೆಂದವರಿಲ್ಲ
riddle_english: No ploughing, no sowing, no threshing floor, no heap, no granary, no net cast and no fish caught; yet when packed in a basket and sold, no one refuses it.

riddle_original: ಭೂಮಿ ಮೇಲೆ ಬೆಳೆಯೋದಲ್ಲ; ಅಂಗಡೀಲಿ ಮಾರೋದಲ್ಲ; ಒಡೆದರೆ ಬೀಜವಿಲ್ಲ; ಸುಲಿದರೆ ಸಿಪ್ಪೆಯಿಲ್ಲ; ತಿಂದರೆ ಹೊಟ್ಟೆ ತುಂಬೋದಲ್ಲ; ಆದರೂ, ಮಳೆ ಬಂದಾಗ ಬೆಳೆ ಇಟ್ಟಾಡ್ತದೆ.
riddle_english: It does not grow on earth; it is not sold in a shop; if broken it has no seed; if peeled it has no skin; eating it does not fill the stomach; yet when it rains, a crop appears.

riddle_original: ಮಾಯದ ಕುದುರೆ ಅಂಬರದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಡುತ್ತೆ; ಕಣ್ಣೀಂದ ನೋಡಬಹುದು, ವಾಸನೆ ಹಿಡಿಯಬಹುದು; ಆದರೆ, ಕೈಯಿಂದ ಜಾರುತ್ತೆ; ದೂರ ದೂರ ಸರಿಯುತ್ತೆ.
riddle_english: A magical horse plays in the sky; it can be seen by the eye and smelled by the nose, but it slips from the hand and keeps moving away.

riddle_original: ಅಗಿದರೆ ಹಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಸಿಕ್ಕೊಲ್ಳ, ಹಿಡಿದರೆ ಕೈಗೆ ಸಿಕ್ಕೊಲ್ಲ; ಕಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಕಾಣೊಲ್ಲ, ಬಿಟ್ಟರೆ ನಿಲ್ಲೊಲ್ಲ.
riddle_english: If chewed it does not get caught in teeth; if held it does not stay in the hand; it cannot be seen by the eye; if released it will not stand still.

riddle_original: ಮಿರಮಿರಮಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಕುಯ್ಯುವವರಿಲ್ಲ, ಮುಡಿಯುವವರಿಲ್ಲ.
riddle_english: Jasmine-like things glitter, but no one plucks them and no one wears them.

riddle_original: ಅಮ್ಮನ ಸೀರೆ, ಭಾರಿ ನೀಲಿ ಸೀರೆ, ನೆರಿಗೆ ಎಣಿಸೋಕೆ ನಾರಾಯಣನಿಗೂ ಸಾಧ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ
riddle_english: Mother's sari is a great blue sari; even Narayana cannot count its pleats.

riddle_original: ಆಕಾಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಇರೋದಲ್ಲ, ನೆಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿಯೋದಲ್ಲ, ಕಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಕಂಡರೂ ಕೈ ಸೇರೋದಲ್ಲ, ಕಾಸು ಕೊಟ್ಟು ಕೊಳ್ಳೋದಲ್ಲ, ಬೀಜ ಬಿತ್ತಿ ಬೆಳೆಯೋದಲ್ಲ, ಉಂಡರೂ ಹೊಟ್ಟೆ ತುಂಬೋದಲ್ಲ
riddle_english: It is not in the sky, does not remain on the ground, can be seen but not held, cannot be bought, cannot be sown, and does not fill the stomach when eaten.

riddle_original: ಅರುಣಾಚಲದಲ್ಲಿ ನೆಟ್ಟ ಅವರು ಮೇಲೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಚಪ್ಪರ ಏರಿ ಕುದುರೆ ಮುಖದಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಡಿ ಮಗುಚಿತು.
riddle_english: Planted in Arunachala, climbed the canopy in the upper world, and fell into the horse's mouth at dusk.

riddle_original: ಕಣ್ಣಿಂದ ನೋಡಲಾರೆ, ಕೈಹಿಡಿದು ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಲಾರೆ, ಅದ ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಇರಲಾರೆ
riddle_english: I cannot see it with the eye, cannot hold it by the hand, yet cannot live without it.

riddle_original: ಕೊಂಬುಂಟು ಆಕಳಲ್ಲ, ಬಾಲವುಂಟು-ಕೋಡಗನಲ್ಲ, ಹಾರುವೆನು-ಹದ್ದಲ್ಲ, ಸೂತ್ರವುಂಟು-ಸೂತ್ರಧಾರಿಯಲ್ಲ, ಸಾವುಂಟು-ಗಾಳಿ ನಿಂತಾಗ. ಹಾಗಾದರೆ ನಾನ್ಯಾರು?
riddle_english: It has horns but is not a cow; a tail but not a bull; it flies but is not an eagle; it has a string but is no puppeteer; it dies when the wind stops. What am I?

riddle_original: ಗೋಳಾಕಾರವುಂಟು-ಸೀಬೇಕಾಯಿಯಲ್ಲ, ಪಟ್ಟೆ ಆರುಂಟು-ಹೀರೇಕಾಯಿಯಲ್ಲ, ಒಳಗೆ ಹುಳಿಯುಂಟು-ನಿಂಬೇಕಾಯಿಯಲ್ಲ, ಮೇಲೆ ಹಸಿರುಂಟು-ಹೇರಳೇಕಾಯಿಯಲ್ಲ, ಬೆಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಹಳುಂಟು-ಅದ ನೋಡದವರಿಲ್ಲ.
riddle_english: Round but not a guava; has stripes but not a ridge gourd; sour inside but not a lemon; green outside but not a hog plum; found much on hills and seen by all.

riddle_original: ಅರ್ಜುನ-ಅರ್ಜುನನ ಹೆಂಡತಿ, ಕೃಷ್ಣ-ಕೃಷ್ಣನ ತಂಗಿ ಇವರೆಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಮೂರು ರೊಟ್ಟಿಗಳನ್ನು ಸಮನಾಗಿ ಹಂಚಬೇಕು; ಆದರೆ ರೊಟ್ಟಿ ಮುರಿಯಬಾರದು.
riddle_english: Arjuna, Arjuna's wife, Krishna, and Krishna's sister must share three rotis equally without breaking any roti.

riddle_original: ಅವ ಹೆಣ್ಣಿಂದ ಕೆಟ್ಟ, ಇವ ಮಣ್ಣಿಂದ ಕೆಟ್ಟ. ಯಾರು ಈ ಪುರಾಣ ಪುರುಷರು
riddle_english: One was ruined by a woman, the other by land. Which mythic men are they?

riddle_original: ಅಕ್ಕತಂಗೇರು ಒಂದೇ ಕುಲ; ಹೆತ್ತ ಮಕ್ಕಳನ್ನು ಪರರಿಗೆ ಕೊಟ್ಟು ಖಾಲಿ ತೊಟ್ಟಿಲು ತೂಗ್ತಾರೆ. ಬಸಿರಾಗೋದು ಭಾರ ಹೊರೋದು ಇದಿಷ್ಟೇ ಅವರ ಕೆಲಸ.
riddle_english: Sisters of the same clan give their children to others and rock empty cradles; becoming pregnant and bearing weight is their only work.

riddle_original: ಅಪ್ಪಹಲ್ಲುಬೀರ, ಅವ್ವ ತಲೆಗೆದರಿ, ಮಗ ನಯಗಾರ
riddle_english: Father shows teeth, mother wears a head-covering, son is gentle.

riddle_original: ಅಪ್ಪಪ್ಪ ಮರದೆತ್ತರ ನೋಡು, ಉಳೋ ಹೈದ ಹತ್ತೋದು ನೋಡು, ಮಳೆಬೀಳದೆ ಕೆರೆ ತುಂಬೋದು ನೋಡು, ಬಂದ ಬೆಳೆ ದೇವರ ಪಾದ ಸೇರೋದು ನೋಡು.
riddle_english: See how tall the father's tree is; see how the child climbs it; see the pond fill without rain; see the crop reach God's feet.

riddle_original: ಎಳೆತನದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲೆ ಹಸಿರು, ಯೌವನದಲ್ಲಿ ನಸುಕೆಂಪು, ಮುಪ್ಪಿನಲಿ ಕಡುಕಪ್ಪು, ರುಚಿಯಲಿ ಒಗರು, ವೈದ್ಯರಲ್ಲಿ ಬಲು ಹೆಸರು.
riddle_english: In childhood it is leafy green, in youth reddish, in old age deep black; astringent in taste and famous among physicians.

riddle_original: ಎರೆಮಣ್ಣು, ಎರೆಮಣ್ಣು ಹೆಂಟ್ಯಾಡ, ಹೂ ಜೋತಾಡ, ಕಾಯಿ ನೇತಾಡ
riddle_english: Red soil, red-soil mound; flowers hang, fruits dangle.

riddle_original: ಅಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಗಣ ಪುಟ್ಟಣ್ಣ; ಅಮ್ಮನ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಇಳಿಸಣ್ಣ ಜಡೆಯದು ಕಂಡಿತು ನೋಡಣ್ಣ!
riddle_english: Little Putta on the loft; bring him down below mother, and a small braid can be seen.

riddle_original: ಉದ್ದುದ್ದವನೆ, ಉರಿಮುಖದವನೆ, ಕೆಂಡಕಾದು ಊರಿಗೆಲ್ಲ ಸುದ್ದಿಹೇಳೋ ಮಗನೆ!
riddle_english: Long fellow, fiery-faced fellow, heated by embers, telling news to the whole village.

riddle_original: ಉದ್ದಾನೆ ಕಾಲಿನ ಮೇಲೆ, ಮದ್ದಾನೆ ಮೈಹೊತ್ತು, ಹೊತ್ತವಳೆ ನೂರೆಂಟು ಹರವೀಯ
riddle_english: On a long leg it carries a heavy body; the bearer spreads out a hundred and eight fronds.

riddle_original: ನಾಲಿಗೆ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಪಾಠ ಹೇಳುತ್ತೇನೆ, ಕೈ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಚಿತ್ರ ಬಿಡಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ, ಕಪ್ಪಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ ಬಿಳಿಯಾಗಿ ಅರಳುತ್ತೇನೆ.
riddle_english: I teach lessons without a tongue, draw without hands, and bloom white when I am black.

riddle_original: ಬಾಯಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಮಾತು ತುಂಬಿದೆ, ಕಣ್ಣಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಜಗ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ತೆರೆದರೆ ಗುರು, ಮುಚ್ಚಿದರೆ ಮೌನ.
riddle_english: It is full of speech without a mouth, shows the world without eyes; opened, it is a teacher; closed, it is silent.

riddle_original: ತಲೆ ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿದಂತೆ ಚಿಕ್ಕದಾಗುತ್ತೇನೆ, ಆದರೂ ಜ್ಞಾನಕ್ಕೆ ದಾರಿ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ.
riddle_english: I become shorter as if my head is cut, yet I show the way to knowledge.

riddle_original: ಬಿಳಿ ಹೊಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಪ್ಪು ಬೀಜ ಬಿತ್ತುತ್ತೇನೆ; ಕೊಯ್ಲು ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.
riddle_english: I sow black seeds on a white field; when harvested, knowledge is gained.

riddle_original: ಗಂಟೆ ಹೊಡೆದರೆ ಎಲ್ಲರು ಓಡುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಅದು ನಡೆಯುವುದಿಲ್ಲ, ಶಾಲೆ ಸಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
riddle_english: When it rings, everyone runs; it does not walk, yet it moves the school day.

riddle_original: ನೆಟ್ಟಗೆ ನಿಂತರೆ ರೇಖೆ, ತಿರುಗಿಸಿದರೆ ಕೋನ, ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಕೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜ್ಯಾಮಿತಿ ಜನಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
riddle_english: Straight it gives a line, turned it gives an angle; in children's hands geometry is born.

riddle_original: ತಪ್ಪನ್ನು ತಿನ್ನುತ್ತದೆ, ಸತ್ಯವನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಕಾಗದದ ಮೇಲೆ ಮೌನ ವೈದ್ಯ.
riddle_english: It eats mistakes and leaves the truth; a silent doctor on paper.

riddle_original: ಒಂದು ಮನೆಯೊಳಗೆ ಸಾವಿರ ಮಕ್ಕಳು; ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರಿಗೂ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ, ಹೆಸರಿಲ್ಲ.
riddle_english: In one house are a thousand children; each has a number but no name.

riddle_original: ದಿಕ್ಕು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಆದರೆ ನಡೆದು ಹೋಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ; ವೃತ್ತ ಬಿಡುತ್ತದೆ ಆದರೆ ಚಕ್ರವಲ್ಲ.
riddle_english: It shows direction but never walks; it draws a circle but is not a wheel.

riddle_original: ಗುರು ಕೇಳಿದ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗೆ ಮೌನವಾಗಿ ನಿಂತಿರುತ್ತದೆ; ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಉತ್ತರ ಬಂದರೆ ಮುಖ ತುಂಬುತ್ತದೆ.
riddle_english: It stands silent at the teacher's question; when children answer, its face fills up.

riddle_original: ಕೈಯಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಬರೆಯುತ್ತೇನೆ, ಬಾಯಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಮಾತಾಡುತ್ತೇನೆ, ಸಾವಿರ ಮೈಲಿ ದೂರದವನನ್ನು ಕ್ಷಣದಲ್ಲೇ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ. ನಾನಾರು?
riddle_english: I write without hands, speak without a mouth, and show someone thousands of miles away in a moment. What am I?

riddle_original: ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಕಪ್ಪು ಪೆಟ್ಟಿಗೆ, ಕಣ್ಣಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಎಲ್ಲ ನೋಡುತ್ತದೆ, ನೆನಪಿಲ್ಲದವರ ನೆನಪು ಕಾಯುತ್ತದೆ.
riddle_english: A small black box sees everything without eyes and preserves the memory of those who forget.

riddle_english: I travel the world without legs, enter the house without a door, and bring news without paper.

riddle_english: I am the elders' carving tree. Who am I?

riddle_original: Inze mbecha mukhululwa tsimbalu ja bakhale. Inze nanyina?
riddle_english: I am the elders' ritual plant. Who am I?

riddle_english: I am the body part for hearing. Who am I?

riddle_original: Inze khukhula khwe khubalola tsimbiso. Inze nanyina?

riddle_original: Inze khukhula khwe khubalola tsimboko. Inze nanyina?
riddle_english: I am the body part for thinking. Who am I?

riddle_original: Huet dem ungaresche Premier eng op de Bak ginn.
riddle_english: Gave the Hungarian Prime Minister a slap in the face.

riddle_original: Ass de CEO vum Land.
riddle_english: Is the CEO of the country.

riddle_original: Ex-Minister dee reegelméisseg am Summer säin eegenen Tour de France fiert.
riddle_english: Ex-minister who regularly rides his own Tour de France duri summer.

riddle_original: Déi schwaarz Partei.
riddle_english: The black party.

riddle_original: De Maart op deem politesch Entscheedunge getraff ginn.
riddle_english: The market where political decisions are made.

riddle_original: Aner Bezeechnung fir den éischte Bierger vum Land.
riddle_english: Another term for the first citizen of the country.
reference_answer_english: President of the Chamber of Deputies

riddle_original: Eng wirtschaftspolitesch Kooperatioun mat engem Nopeschland an engem Net-Nopeschland.
riddle_english: A politico-economic cooperation with one neighbouring and one non-neighouring country.

riddle_original: De fréiere Grand-Duc, deen e Problem mat Stiefhëllef hat an eng konstitutionell Kris ausgeléist hat.
riddle_english: The former Grand Duke who had an issue with euthanasia and caused a constitutional crisis.

riddle_original: Wéi vill Leit treffen sech reegelméisseg direkt nieft dem Palais fir Ofstëmmungen?
riddle_english: How many people meet regularly right next to the Palais for negotiations?

riddle_original: Bei dësem Event diskutéiere Staat, Patronat a Gewerkschaften op engem Dësch.
riddle_english: At this event, the state, employers, and unions discuss at one table.

riddle_original: E Monument dat wärend dem 2. Weltkrich verschwonnen an dono rëm opgetaucht ass.
riddle_english: A monument that disappeared during World War 2 and later resurfaced.

riddle_original: Grof, deem seng physesch Behënnerung zum Deel vu sengem Numm ginn ass.
riddle_english: Count whose physical disability became part of his name.
reference_answer_english: John of Bohemia (literal: John the Blind)

riddle_original: Historesch ënnerierdesch Tunnellen.
riddle_english: Historic underground tunnels.

riddle_original: Firma déi d'Lëtzebuerger Industrie am 20. Joerhonnert gepräägt huet.
riddle_english: Company that shaped Luxembourg's industry in the 20th century.

riddle_original: Eng bis ewell ongeléisten explosiv Affär aus den 90er Joren.
riddle_english: A still-unsolved explosive affair from the 90s.

riddle_original: Gebuer zu Lëtzebuerg a spéider franséische Premier a mat verantwortlech fir d'Grënnung vun der EU.
riddle_english: Born in Luxembourg and later French Prime Minister, and partly responsible for the founding of the EU.

riddle_original: Ech sinn am Januar gebuer mee dat ganzt Land féiert mäi Gebuertsdag 6 Méint mei spéit.
riddle_english: I was born in January, but the whole country celebrates my birthday 6 months later.

riddle_original: Eng wichteg Schluecht am Zweete Weltkrich, déi sech am Wanter 1944/1945 an der Belsch an zu Lëtzebuerg ofgespillt huet.
riddle_english: An important battle in World Was II, which occurred in Belgium and Luxembourg during the winter of 1944/1945

riddle_original: Den "Ardennegrof" a Grënner vu Lëtzebuerg.
riddle_english: The "Count of the Ardennes" and founder of Luxembourg.

riddle_original: An dësem Joer ass Lëtzebuerg "aus dem Ee gesprong".
riddle_english: That year, Luxembourg has '"jumped out of the egg".

riddle_original: Floss laanscht dee Wäibau stattfënnt.
riddle_english: River along which viticulture takes place.

riddle_original: Méi wéi eng Millioun Autoe ginn hei all Joer opgefëllt.
riddle_english: More than a million cars are filled up here every year.

riddle_original: D'Stad an déi vill portugisesch Matbierger tëschent Abrëll a Juni hi pilgeren.
riddle_english: The city that many Portuguese fellow citizens make a pilgrimage to between April and June.

riddle_original: Den nërdlechen Deel vum Land.
riddle_english: The northern part of the country.

riddle_original: Den Deel vum Land wou fréier Eisenäerz ofgebaut gouf.
riddle_english: The part of the country where iron ore used to be mined.

riddle_original: Regioun am Oste benannt no engem anere Land.
riddle_english: Region in the east named after another country.

riddle_original: Déi meeschte Leit, déi Schlittschong fueren, maachen dëst an dëser Uertschaft.
riddle_english: Most people who go ice skating do so in this town.

riddle_original: An dëser Uertschaft kann ee besonnesch vill Päiperleke gesinn.
riddle_english: In this town you can see especially many butterflies.

riddle_original: Uertschaft am Süde bekannt fir hire groussen Undeel u portugisesche Matbierger.
riddle_english: Town in the south known for its large share of Portuguese fellow citizens.

riddle_original: Zwou Uertschafte mat demselwechten Numm, eng am Süden an eng am Norden, déi duerch ënnerschiddlech Flëss gekennzeechent sinn.
riddle_english: Two settlements with the same name, one in the south and one in the north, distinguished by different rivers.

riddle_original: Lëtzebuerger Auteur deen virun allem bekannt gouf fir sain Wierk benannt no engem Déier.
riddle_english: Luxembourgish author who became known primarily for his work named after an animal.

riddle_original: De wuel bekannteste Lëtzebuerger Superheld.
riddle_english: The probably best-known Luxembourgish superhero.

riddle_original: Eng lëtzebuergesch Serie déi op Netflix a ville Länner op Plaz 1 war.
riddle_english: A Luxembourgish series that was number 1 on Netflix in many countries.

riddle_original: Wéi ee Concours muss ee gewannen fir Lëtzbuerg bei der Eurovisioun ze vertrieden?
riddle_english: Which contest must one win to represent Luxembourg at the Eurovision?

riddle_original: Dëse lëtzebuergesche Muséker wuar frou mat zwou Bulle Mocca.
riddle_english: This Luxembourgish musician was happy about two scoops of mocca.

riddle_original: E Lidd vum Fausti, wou den Titel e Wuertspill iwwert en ostafrikanescht Land enthält.
riddle_english: A song by Fausti, the title of which contains a pun on an East African country

riddle_original: Dëse Musée mat engem "nossegem" Numm ass an engem fréiere Fort um Kierchbierg.
riddle_english: This museum with a "nutty" name is in a former fort in Kirchberg.

riddle_original: Eng vun de bekannteste Concertshale vu Lëtzebuerg, situéiert um Belval.
riddle_english: One of the most well-known concert halls in Luxembourg, situated in Belval.

riddle_original: Lëtzebuerger Auteur dee säi Spëtznumm der franséischer "zéng" verdankt.
riddle_english: Luxembourgish author who owes his nickname to the French word for "ten."

riddle_original: Op Nationalfeierdag gëtt dësem Auteur säin Text besonnesch oft gesongen.
riddle_english: On National Day, this author's text is sung especially often.

riddle_original: De Familljennumm vun 2 Bridder vu Mondorf déi laang zesumme Weltklass am selwechte Sport waren.
riddle_english: The family name of 2 brothers from Mondorf who were world-class athletes in the same sport for a long time.

riddle_original: Gewënner vun der éischter olympescher Goldmedail fir Lëtzebuerg nom 2. Weltkrich.
riddle_english: Winner of Luxembourg's first Olympic gold medal after WWII.

riddle_original: Keen Telefonsbuch ass sécher virun him.
riddle_english: No phone book is safe from him.

riddle_original: Ass vu Grand Slams an d'Chamber gewiesselt.
riddle_english: Switched from Grand Slams to Parliament.

riddle_original: Stand 2024 ass et nach ni eng mei al olympesch Sportlerin wei dës Lëtzebuergerin an hirer Sportaart ginn.
riddle_english: As of 2024, there has never been an older female Olympic athlete than this Luxembourger in her sport.

riddle_original: D'Gesamt-Unzuel u Goler déi d'Lëtzebuerger Härefussballnationalekipp bei Welt- an Europameeschterschafte geschoss huet, Stand 2026.
riddle_english: The total number of goals that the Luxembourg men's national football team has scored at World and European Championships, as of 2026.

riddle_original: 2017 sinn eng Fra an e Mann vu Lëtzebuerg zesummen an dëser Sportaart Weltmeeschter ginn.
riddle_english: In 2017, a woman and a man from Luxembourg became both world champions in this sport.

riddle_original: 2008 gouf Lëtzebuerg Weltmeeschter an dësem Volleyball-änlechem Teamsport.
riddle_english: 2008, Luxembourg became world champion at this volleyball-like teamsport.
riddle_hint: De Sport ass eng Variant vum brasilianeschem Sport Peteca a gëtt mat engem Fiederball-änlechem Ball gespillt.

riddle_original: Dat gréisst Lafevent am Land, dat uechter d'Haaptstad féiert.
riddle_english: The country's biggest running event, which leads throught the capital.

riddle_original: E Sportscenter, deem seng Form un eng Muschel erënnert.
riddle_english: A sports centre, the shape of which looks like a clam.

riddle_original: En Déier aus Porzeläin, wat päift wann een dra bléist.
riddle_english: A porcelain animal that whistles when you blow into it.

riddle_original: Déi gréisste Kiermes vum Joer.
riddle_english: The biggest fair of the year.

riddle_original: E järleche Maart op deem ee Villercher aus Porzeläin ze kafe kritt.
riddle_english: An annual market where you can buy porcelain birds.

riddle_original: E Cortège, bei deem d'Léit net trëppelen, mee sprangen.
riddle_english: A procession where people don't walk but jump.

riddle_original: E Brauch bei deem eng bestëmmte Joreszäit verbrannt gëtt.
riddle_english: A custom where a certain season is burned.

riddle_original: Wann een dëse Cortège gesäit da weess een dass d'Kiermes ufänkt.
riddle_english: When you see this procession, you know the fair is starting.

riddle_original: Eng Period vu genau 2 Woche wou d'Kathedral iwwerduerchschnëttlech vill besicht gëtt.
riddle_english: A period of exactly 2 weeks when the cathedral gets an unusually high number of visitors.

riddle_original: Museker déi franséisch Juegdharen blosen.
riddle_english: Musicians who play French hunting horns.

riddle_original: Bei dëser Aktivitéit gëtt eng Mauer ouni Bëton gebaut.
riddle_english: In this activity, a wall is built without concrete.

riddle_original: Déi lëtzebuergesch Versioun vu Vältesdag, déi op de leschte Sonndeg am März fällt.
riddle_english: The Luxembourgish version of Valentine's Day that falls on the fourth Sunday in March.

riddle_original: Ech brénge Saache fir ze kucken an ze schmaachen aus dem Himmelsland, Wie sinn ech?
riddle_english: I bring things to look at and taste from the land of heaven. Who am I?

riddle_original: Däischter ugedoe, deelt Rutten aus u Kanner, déi sech net geschéckt hunn.
riddle_english: Dressed in dark clothes, hands out rods to naughty kids.

riddle_original: Op dësem Dag froe Kanner no Speck an Ierbessen.
riddle_english: On this day, children ask for bacon and peas.

riddle_original: Klemmt e Männchen d'Leeder rop, wat well e plécken?
riddle_english: A little man climbs up the ladder, what does he want to pick?

riddle_original: Wat muss gerëselt gi fir dass déi schéinsten Dreem eroffalen?
riddle_english: What must be shaken so that the most beautiful dreams fall down?

riddle_original: Wie vu Beetebuerg op Réiser ënnerwee ass an Déiere well gesinn, kann dat am beschte wou maachen?
riddle_english: When traveling from Beetebuerg to Réiser and wanting to see animals, where's the best place to do that?

riddle_original: Dëse Bouf ass den Haaptcharakter a sëllege Kannerwitzer.
riddle_english: This boy is the main character in numerous children's jokes.

riddle_original: Doduerch gëtt et 4 Deeg laang virun Ouschtere relativ haart an de Stroossen.
riddle_english: Because of this, the streets are relatively loud for 4 days before Easter.

riddle_original: Eng ëffentlech Ariichtung déi et an all Gemeng gëtt fir Kanner no der Schoul ze betreien.
riddle_english: A public facility that exists in every municipality to look after children after school.

riddle_original: E fakultative Schoulzyklus virun der Spillschoul.
riddle_english: An optional school cycle before kindergarten

riddle_original: Eng Planz mee awer och eng lëtzebuergesch Supermarchéschaîne.
riddle_english: A plant, but also a Luxembourgish supermarket chain.

riddle_original: Eeler Leit rechnen oft net an Euro mee a...
riddle_english: Older people often don't calculate in Euros but in...

riddle_original: Ech huelen de Bus vun Esch bis an d'Stat. Wat kascht mech dat (an €)?
riddle_english: I take the bus from Esch to the City. What does it cost me (in €)?

riddle_original: Fiert queesch duerch d'Staat an hänkt un enger elektrescher Leitung.
riddle_english: Travels across the City and is attached to an electric line.

riddle_original: Ech well bei d'Mier mee well sou mann wäit fuere wéi méiglech. An wéi e Land muss ech fueren?
riddle_english: I want to go to the seaside but want to drive as little distance as possible. Which country should I go to?

riddle_original: Ech hu mäi Führerschäi verluer a muss un eng Formatioun deel huele fir e rëm ze kréien. An wéi eng Uertschaft muss ech dofir?
riddle_english: I lost my driver's license and have to take part in a training course to get it back. Which town do I need to go to for that?

riddle_original: An wéi e Land fueren déi meeschte Léit op engem Wochendag no 16h00?
riddle_english: To which country do most people travel on a weekday after 16:00?

riddle_original: Wat ass op der Récksäit vu lëtzebuergeschen Euromënzen ze fannen?
riddle_english: What can you find on the reverse side of Luxembourgish Euro coins?

riddle_original: Eng wëchentlech Zäitschrëft, déi Artikelen iwwert aktuell Themen an de Fernsehsprogramm enthält.
riddle_english: A weekly magazine that contains articles about current-day topics and a television guide.

riddle_original: Wann d'Präisser klammen, suergt dëse Mechanismus dofir dass och d'Paie klammen.
riddle_english: When prices rise, this mechanism ensures that wages rise as well.

riddle_original: Ech gi gerappt, mee ech si kee Witz, Ech ginn an Uelech gezappt, mee ech si keng Fritt. Wat sinn ech?
riddle_english: I am grated, but I am not a joke, I am dipped in oil, but I am not a chip/French fry. What am I?
riddle_note: This riddle contains a play on words with the word "rappen" ("to grate") "Grating a joke" is a Luxembourgish way to say "making a joke"

riddle_original: Eng Mëtsch, déi d'Form vun engem Mënsch huet an et am Chrëschtmount ze kafe gëtt.
riddle_english: A pastry, that is formed like a human, and is available to buy during Christmas time.

riddle_original: En traditionellt Geriicht aus Miel, Mëllech, Eeër a Salz, wat entweder mat Speck oder enger Ramzooss zervéiert gëtt.
riddle_english: A traditional dish made from flour, milk, eggs, and salt, which is served with either lard, or a cream sauce.

riddle_original: Eng Zopp, déi traditionell mat grénge Bounen a Grompere gemaach gëtt.
riddle_english: A soup that is traditionally made from green beans and potatoes.

riddle_original: Dëse Mëllechproduit ass d'Source vun dem Superjhemp sénge Kräften.
riddle_english: This dairy product is the source of Superjhemp's powers.

riddle_original: Dës Wurscht gëtt traditionell mat enger Moschter-baséierter Zooss giess.
riddle_english: This sausage is typically eaten with a mustard-based sauce.

riddle_original: Vill Lëtzebuerger besëtzen e Kachbuch mat traditionelle Platen, wat no dëser aflossräicher Auteurin a Kächin benannt gouf.
riddle_english: Many Luxembourger own a cookbook with traditional dishes named after this influential female author and cook.

riddle_original: Dës knuetfërmeg Mëtsche gi gäre wärend der Fueszäit giess.
riddle_english: This knot-shaped pastry is usually enjoyed during carnival.

riddle_original: Dës bekannte lëtzebuergesch Kächin ass bis haut (2026) déi eenzeg Fra, déi de Bocuse d'Or gewonnen huet.
riddle_english: This famous Luxembourgish chef is to date (2026) the only woman to win the Bocuse d'Or.
riddle_hint: Si bedreift e Restaurant zu Fréiseng, wat no hir benannt ass an 1987 hiren éischte Michelin-Stär krut.

riddle_original: Eng Mëtsch, déi Männer um véierte Sonndeg am März hirer Partnerin schenken, ausser et ass e Schaltjoer.
riddle_english: A pastry that men gift to their (romantic) partner on the fourth Sunday in March, unless it's a leap year.

riddle_original: Fréier hunn d'Leit gegleeft, dass dëst Déier Mëllech aus den Audere vu Kéi gesuckelt huet.
riddle_english: People used to believe that this animal sucked milk from the udders of cows.

riddle_original: E klengt, punktéiert Insekt, wat dem Numm no duerch d'Firmament flitt.
riddle_english: A small, spotted insect that, according to its name, travels through the sky.

riddle_original: E fläissegt Déier, wat dem Numm no eng Seier urinéiert, wann et a Gefor ass.
riddle_english: A busy animal which, according to its name, urinates acid when in danger.

riddle_original: Den Numm vun dësem Reptil kléngt no enger zougedeckter Amphibie.
riddle_english: The name of this reptile sounds like a covered amphibian.

riddle_original: E klengt Déier, wat trotz séngem Numm weder beim Waasser wunnt nach Famill mat Schwäin ass.
riddle_english: A small animal that despite its name does not live near water nor is related to pigs.

riddle_original: Eng Echsenaart, déi, trotz hirem Numm, keng sou schlecht Aen huet.
riddle_english: A type of lizard that, despite its name, doesn't have such bad eyes.

riddle_original: E Knabberdéier, wat säin Numm vun enger Aart vun Nëss kritt, déi et gäre fir de Wanter vergrueft.
riddle_english: A rodent that get its name from a type of nut that it likes to bury before winter.

riddle_original: E Villche mat engem ausgepräägtem Karunkel, wat, trotz sengem Numm, net erkaalt ass.
riddle_english: A bird with a prounounced snood that, despite its name, does not have a cold.

riddle_original: En Déier, wat net nëmmen dem Numm no ganz liddereg ass.
riddle_english: An animal that is fittingly named "lazy".

riddle_original: E wierbellost Déier, wat dem Numm no aus enger gelatinnsaarteger Substanz besteet.
riddle_english: An invertebrate animal, which according to its name consists of a gelatinous substance.

riddle_original: Lelaki pertama memimpin seluruh negara, wajahnya dicetakkan di Ringgit Malaysia lima puluh.
riddle_english: The first man to lead the whole nation, whose face is printed on Malaysia’s fifty-ringgit note.

riddle_original: Bapa pembangunan Malaysia, dia diingati dengan pencipta Rukun Negara, membina sekolah untuk seluruh negara. Pemimpin yang paling muda di Malaysia.
riddle_english: Malaysia’s Father of Development, remembered as the architect of the Rukun Negara and for building schools across the nation. The youngest leader in Malaysia.

riddle_original: 1MBD skandal, perdana menteri pertama yang dipenjarakan.
riddle_english: The 1MDB scandal, the first prime minister to be jailed.

riddle_original: Orang Cina pertama yang menjadi Ketua Menteri di Penang, Menteri Kewangan juga tanggungjawabnya dahulu. Lim Kit Siang bapanya.
riddle_english: The first Chinese person to become Chief Minister of Penang; he also once held the Finance Ministry portfolio. Lim Kit Siang is his father.

riddle_original: Pertama timbalan perdana menteri yang dipenjarakan dua kali sebelum menjadi Perdana Menteri kini.
riddle_english: First, the deputy prime minister who was jailed twice before becoming the current Prime Minister.

riddle_original: Wanita pertama yang memikul tanggungjawab sebagai timbalan perdana menteri.
riddle_english: The first woman to shoulder the responsibility of serving as Deputy Prime Minister.

riddle_original: Seorang menteri wanita yang bertungkus lumus membina pelaburan, perdagangan dan industri malaysia untuk 21 tahun.
riddle_english: A woman minister who worked tirelessly to build up Malaysia’s investment, trade, and industry for 21 years.

riddle_original:
Pergi ke sawah menanam padi,
Padi ditanam elok dijaga,
Perdana Menteri ketiga negara,
Dikenali sebagai Bapa Perpaduan bangsa.
riddle_english:
Go to the paddy field to plant rice,
Once planted, the rice must be well tended,
The nation’s third Prime Minister,
Known as the Father of Unity.

riddle_original:
Burung merpati terbang melayang,
Hinggap sebentar di dahan pisang,
Perdana Menteri kelima yang dikenang,
Membawa gagasan Islam Hadhari yang dikembang.
riddle_english:
A pigeon soars, gliding through the sky,
Resting a while on a banana branch nearby,
The fifth Prime Minister, fondly recalled,
Who advanced the concept of Islam Hadhari for all.

riddle_original:
Pergi ke kedai membeli ubi,
Ubi dimakan sedap semua,
Perdana Menteri keenam tersangkut kes 1MDB,
Anak kepada Tun Razak, bekas perdana menteri kedua.
riddle_english:
Went to the shop to buy cassava,
The cassava was eaten, every bite delicious,
The sixth Prime Minister was entangled in the 1MDB scandal,
The son of Tun Razak, the former second Prime Minister.

riddle_original:
Burung merpati terbang melayang,
Hinggap sebentar di atas para;
Laksamana setia namanya dikenang,
Berkhidmat teguh kepada negara.
riddle_english:
A dove glides as it flies,
Perching awhile upon the rack;
The loyal admiral—his name remembered,
Serving the nation with steadfast dedication.

riddle_original:
Naik perahu membawa sutera,
Berhenti berteduh di bawah ara;
Dahulu dikenali sebagai Temasek,
Pulau apakah di selatan negara?
riddle_english:
Sailing a boat while carrying silk,
Stopping to rest in the shade of a fig tree;
Once known as Temasek,
Which island lies to the south of the country?

riddle_original:
Pagi-pagi menanam padi,
Padi menguning di hujung laman;
Duduk memerintah berdaulat tinggi,
Menjadi payung kepada kerajaan.
riddle_english:
Early in the morning, planting paddy,
The paddy turns golden at the edge of the yard;
Seated in rule with lofty sovereignty,
Becoming the umbrella of the government.

riddle_original:
Bebas negara daripada penjajahan,
Tiga puluh satu Ogos jadi kenangan.
riddle_english:
The nation was freed from colonial rule,
The thirty-first of August lives on in memory.

riddle_original:
Tiang bendera menjulang tinggi,
Tempat bersejarah merdeka diraikan di sini.
riddle_english:
The flagpole rises high,
A historic place where independence was celebrated here.

riddle_original:
Kapal berlabuh membawa tentera,
Portugis ditewaskan lalu berundur;
Bangunan merah menjadi tanda,
Siapakah kuasa yang memerintah dahulu?
riddle_english:
Ships cast anchor, bringing soldiers ashore;
The Portuguese were defeated and forced to withdraw.
The red building stands as a marker—
Which power ruled here in the past?

riddle_original:
Harta diwarisi mengikut sebelah bapa,
Raja berkuasa memerintah negara.
riddle_english:
Inheritance is passed down through the father’s side,
A ruler holds power to govern the state.

riddle_original:
Harta diwarisi melalui wanita,
Pemimpin dipilih secara muafakat bersama.
riddle_english:
Property is inherited through women,
Leaders are chosen through mutual consensus.

riddle_original:
Pelanduk kecil menendang anjing,
Membuka Melaka, namaku penting.
riddle_english: A little mousedeer kicks a dog; in the founding of Melaka, my name is of great importance.

riddle_original:
Penasihat raja bijak bicara,
Membantu mentadbir aman negara.
riddle_english:
The king’s wise-speaking advisor,
Helping govern the country in peace.

riddle_original:
Bandar bersejarah penuh cerita,
A Famosa menjadi tanda warisannya.
riddle_english:
A historic city filled with stories,
A Famosa stands as a symbol of its heritage.

riddle_original:
Burung merpati terbang ke tepi,
Hinggap sekejap di dahan jati,
Patung Murugan berdiri tinggi,
Tangga seratus tiga puluh dua titi.
riddle_english:
A pigeon flies off to the side,
Perching awhile on a teak branch,
The Murugan statue stands tall,
With one hundred and thirty-two steps to climb.

riddle_original:
Angin menderu di pantai Cenang,
Nelayan pulang membawa udang,
Jambatan lengkung di awan terbentang,
Pemandangan indah dari gunung dipandang.
riddle_english:
The wind roars on Cenang Beach,
Fishermen return with prawns in reach,
A curved bridge stretches across the sky,
A beautiful view is seen from the mountain high.

riddle_original:
Berlayar jauh ke benua Asia,
Cantik bermandi cahaya pagi dini,
Pulau ini terletak di pantai barat laut Semenanjung Malaysia,
George Town, Batu Feringghi terletak di sini.
riddle_english:
Sailing far across the Asian continent,
Beautifully bathed in the early morning light,
This island lies off the northwestern coast of Peninsular Malaysia,
George Town and Batu Ferringhi can be found here.

riddle_original:
Kabus turun waktu pagi,
Menyelubungi bukit dan lembah,
Strawberi merah dipetik di sini,
Bunga di ladang pelbagai warna indah.
riddle_english:
Morning mist descends,
Blanketing hills and valleys,
Red strawberries are picked here,
And flowers bloom in fields of many beautiful colours.

riddle_original:
Sungai mengalir dari hulu,
Membawa air jernih dan bersih,
Hutan hujan tertua di dunia dahulu,
Flora fauna kaya terpelihara bersih.
riddle_english:
A river flows down from its source,
Carrying water clear and clean,
The world’s oldest tropical rainforest from ancient times,
Rich flora and fauna carefully preserved pristine.

riddle_original:
Gunung menjulang bagai dalam foto,
Berdiri teguh sejak dahulu,
Negeri ini terletak di utara pulau Borneo,
Ibu negerinya Kota Kinabalu.
riddle_english:
A mountain rises high, as if in a photograph,
Standing proudly since ancient times,
This state lies in the north of the island of Borneo,
Its capital is Kota Kinabalu.

riddle_original:
Pergi ke pekan naik basikal,
Basikal baru berwarna perang,
Gunung tertinggi di Sabah dikenali kekal,
Puncak berbatu dituju pendaki serantau.
riddle_english:
Ride a bicycle into town,
A brand-new bicycle, brown in hue,
Sabah’s highest mountain is forever renowned,
Its rocky summit draws climbers from across the region.

riddle_original:
Kabus menyelubungi rimba,
Legenda hidup sejak dahulu kala,
Gunung di Johor menyimpan cerita lama,
Puteri jelmaan konon bersemayam di sana.
riddle_english:
Mist shrouds the jungle,
A legend lives on from ages past,
A mountain in Johor holds an old tale,
Where a princess in mortal form is said to dwell.

riddle_original:
Terpisah kerana adat yang berlainan,
Cinta gugur bersama daun-daun kekeringan,
Lagu yang berjudul dengan nama seorang wanita ini keluar pada tahun lapan puluhan,
Menjadi nyanyian peminat rok kapak zaman-berzaman.
riddle_english:
Parted because their customs were different,
Love fell away with the drying leaves,
This song, titled with a woman’s name, was released in the eighties,
And has become an evergreen anthem for fans of Malaysian power ballad rock.

riddle_original:
Duduk bersila di atas pangkin,
Sambil bersiul dengan senang hati,
Lagu ini mempunyai judul berkaitan dengan sejenis kain,
Sebuah klasik yang paling popular oleh Tok Ti.
riddle_english:
Sitting cross-legged on the wooden platform,
Whistling away with a happy heart,
This song bears a title linked to a kind of cloth,
One of Tok Ti’s most popular classics.

riddle_original:
Pokok kelapa tumbuh di tepi paya,
Daunnya melambai ditiup di taman,
Lagu Sudirman ini dimainkan sewaktu Hari Raya,
Untuk mengajak anak-anak muda balik ke kampung halaman.
riddle_english:
A coconut tree grows by the swamp,
Its fronds wave in the breeze in the garden,
This Sudirman song is played during Hari Raya,
To invite the youngsters to return to their hometowns.

riddle_original:
Layang-layang tinggi melayar,
Awan berarak sambil lewa,
Lagu P. Ramlee ini bergetar,
Liriknya halus menusuk jiwa.
riddle_english:
Kites soar high as they glide,
Clouds drift by at ease,
This P. Ramlee song trembles and resonates,
Its delicate lyrics pierce the soul.

riddle_original:
Di dalam semak ada ular,
Di tepi kolam tumbuhnya daun,
Lagu Sheila Majid ini amat popular,
Rancaknya sampai ke Indonesia dan Jepun.
riddle_english:
There’s a snake in the bushes,
By the pond, leaves grow,
This song by Sheila Majid is hugely popular,
Its lively rhythm reached Indonesia and Japan.

riddle_original:
Pagi-pagi memancing ikan,
Riang gembira bersama kanak-kanak,
Lebih dari satu alat ini dipukul di majlis perkahwinan,
Mengiringi pengantin yang datang berarak.
riddle_english:
Early in the morning, fishing for fish,
Cheerful and happy with the children,
More than one of these instruments is beaten at a wedding,
Accompanying the bride and groom as they parade in.

riddle_original:
Budak-budak bermain dengan ombak,
Berlari pulang membawa kayu,
Dua permukaan boleh dihentak,
Tidak seperti kompang yang hanya ada satu.
riddle_english:
Children play in the waves,
Running home carrying wood,
Two surfaces can be struck,
Unlike the kompang, which has only one.

riddle_original:
Pergi berjalan ternampak angsa,
Singgah di sungai ternampak ikan gelama,
Alat muzik ini digantung dan diperbuat dari gangsa,
Dipukul di pusatnya, bunyinya bergema.
riddle_english:
Out for a stroll, I spotted a goose,
Stopping by the river, I saw a croaker fish.
This musical instrument is hung up and made of bronze,
Struck at its centre, its sound resounds.

riddle_original:
Pak Ali menanam pokok kacang,
Kacang dituai riang hati,
Alat muzik ini mempunyai banyak lubang,
Ditiup dan ditutup jari, alunannya merdu sekali.
riddle_english:
Pak Ali plants bean plants,
The beans are harvested with a joyful heart,
This musical instrument has many holes,
It is blown and covered with the fingers, and its melody is truly beautiful.

riddle_original:
Pergi ke kebun memetik jambu,
Buahnya manis dibawa ke Malaysia,
Alat ini diperbuat dari pohon bambu,
Digoncang dengan tangan, popular juga di Indonesia.
riddle_english:
Went to the orchard to pick guavas,
Their sweet fruit was brought back to Malaysia,
This instrument is made from bamboo,
Shaken by hand, and also popular in Indonesia.

riddle_original:
Burung merpati terbang melayang,
Hinggap sebentar di atas pagar;
Bola dilontar masuk ke keranjang,
Pemain melompat tinggi mengejar.
riddle_english:
A dove soars, gliding through the air,
Perching for a while upon the fence;
The ball is thrown into the basket,
Players leap high in pursuit.

riddle_original:
Pagi hari memetik serai,
Serai disusun di atas papan;
Bulu tangkis terbang berderai,
Dipukul raket mencari kemenangan.
riddle_english:
In the morning, picking lemongrass,
The lemongrass is arranged on a wooden board;
A shuttlecock flies back and forth,
Struck by rackets in pursuit of victory.

riddle_original:
Naik perahu menuju seberang,
Membawa bekalan di dalam peti;
Bola kecil dipukul seorang,
Masuk ke lubang menjadi misi.
riddle_english:
Board a boat to cross the strait,
Carrying provisions packed in a chest;
A small ball is struck by a single player,
The mission is to sink it into the hole.

riddle_original:
Anak muda bermain gasing,
Gasing berpusing di tengah halaman;
Bola dipukul dengan kayu panjang,
Pemain berlari mengelilingi kawasan.
riddle_english:
Young people play with spinning tops,
The tops whirl in the middle of the yard;
A ball is hit with a long bat,
The players run around the field.

riddle_original:
Bunga mawar tumbuh berseri,
Disiram orang setiap petang;
Kaki menendang, tangan menepis,
Seni berlawan di tengah gelanggang.
riddle_english:
A rose blooms bright and fair,
Watered every evening with care;
Feet kick out, hands parry the strike,
An art of combat in the middle of the arena.

riddle_original:
Pergi ke padang membawa bola,
Bola disepak ke tengah laman;
Sebelas pemain bekerjasama,
Menjaring gol menjadi tujuan.
riddle_english:
Go to the field carrying a ball,
The ball is kicked into the middle of the pitch;
Eleven players work together,
Scoring goals is the objective.

riddle_original:
Mengambil air dari perigi,
Untuk diberi kepada unta;
Bola dilontar dengan berhati-hati,
Jatuhkan pin untuk berjaya.
riddle_english:
Drawing water from the well,
To give to the camel;
The ball is rolled with care,
Knock down the pins to succeed.

riddle_original:
Pergi ke pekan membeli jala,
Jala dibawa bersama teman;
Bola dilambung lalu dipukul pula,
Enam pemain menjaga gelanggang.
riddle_english:
Went to town to buy a net,
The net was brought along with a friend;
The ball is tossed up and then hit,
Six players guard the court.

riddle_original:
Pergi ke sungai membawa umpan,
Duduk menunggu di tepi titi;
Tali dilontar penuh harapan,
Ikan tersangkut dibawa kembali.
riddle_english:
Go to the river carrying bait,
Sit waiting by the little bridge;
The line is cast with hopeful heart,
A fish is hooked and brought back home.

riddle_original:
Pergi ke taman memetik delima,
Singgah berehat di bawah dahan;
Busur ditarik dengan saksama,
Anak meluncur tepat ke sasaran.
riddle_english:
Go to the garden to pick pomegranates,
Stop to rest beneath a branch;
The bow is drawn with steady balance,
The arrow flies true to its target.

riddle_original: Kembar yang berdiri di Kuala Lumpur, lapan puluh lapan tingkat dengan corak bintang segi lapan.Apabila tiba waktu malam, cahayanya bagai beribu berlian bersinar.
riddle_english: Twins standing tall in Kuala Lumpur, eighty-eight storeys high with an eight-pointed star motif. When night falls, their lights shine like thousands of sparkling diamonds.

riddle_original: Daun pisang yang segar, nasi yang masak dengan santan; kepak ayam goreng atau ikan pun enak, sambal itulah jiwanya!
riddle_english: Fresh banana leaf, rice cooked in coconut milk; fried chicken wings or fish are delicious too, but the sambal is its very soul!

riddle_original: Patung emas bersinar apabila matahari terbit, dua ratus tujuh puluh dua pelangi langkah sampai ke destinasi, gua ini bukan hanya untuk sembahyang, juga untuk kanak kanak mempelihara burung atau monyet.
riddle_english: A golden statue gleams at sunrise; two hundred and seventy-two rainbow steps lead to the destination. This cave is not only for worship, but also where children once kept birds or monkeys.

riddle_original: Bagai layang-layang tetapi besar, buluh itu rangkanya. Zaman dahulu menghalau burung pada waktu pagi, menidurkan kanak pada waktu malam.
riddle_english: Like a kite, but much larger, with bamboo for its frame. In the old days it was used to chase birds away in the morning, and to lull children to sleep at night.

riddle_original: Tempat tujuh kali "merdeka" diisytiharkan, pertama kali bendera Malaysia dinaikan, lambangkan kedaulatan!
riddle_english: The place where “Merdeka” was proclaimed seven times, where the Malaysian flag was first raised—a symbol of sovereignty!

riddle_original: Gunung yang dicetakkan dalam Ringgit  Malaysia Seratus, gunung yang tertinggi di Malaysia.
riddle_english: The mountain featured on the Malaysian one hundred ringgit note, the highest mountain in Malaysia.

riddle_original: Bata merah dari Belanda, dulu kediaman rasmi Belanda sekarang muzium. Peranakan budayanya, sampai kini basikal roda tiga masih digunakan.
riddle_english: Red bricks from the Dutch, once the Dutch official residence and now a museum. Peranakan culture thrives there, and even today trishaws are still in use.

riddle_original: Warna merah tanda beraya, lima kelopak wakili rukun negara. Bunga yang ditanamkan di mana mana, supaya rukun negara diingati di mana mana.
riddle_english: Red in colour, a sign of celebration; its five petals represent the principles of the Rukun Negara. A flower planted everywhere, so that the Rukun Negara is remembered everywhere.

riddle_original: Dahi burung nampak macam terlekat pisang,  bagai memakai topi keledar di langit. Patuknya panjang dan putih, seumur hidup hanya satu isteri.
riddle_english: A bird whose forehead looks as if a banana were stuck on it, like wearing a helmet in the sky. Its beak is long and white, and it keeps only one wife for life.

riddle_original: Bulat tapi bukan bola, sebelum masak perlu buang atas udara. Pelbagai jenis isi boleh ditambah, makan dengan dhal atau kari paling klasik.
riddle_english: Round, but not a ball; before cooking, you toss it up into the air. You can add all kinds of fillings, but the classic way is to eat it with dhal or curry.

riddle_original:
Petang hari bermain di taman,
Kaki melompat mengikut petak;
Batu kecil menjadi taruhan,
Tersalah pijak, giliran tamat.
riddle_english:
In the evening, we play in the park,
Feet hop from square to square;
A small stone is used as the marker,
Step on the wrong line, and your turn is over.

riddle_original:
Pergi ke kebun mencari rotan,
Singgah sebentar di bawah ara;
Biji kecil dilontar dengan tangan,
Lima bersaudara bermain bersama.
riddle_english:
Go to the garden to look for rattan,
Stop awhile beneath the fig tree;
Small seeds are tossed by hand,
Five siblings play together.
